rows.source: Paul Barreira, ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n nípa àisán ọpọlọ ní Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Ìṣègùn ti Havard àti olùdarí ti àwọn iṣẹ́ ètò ìlera ti yunifasiti náà sọpé yunifasiti náà pinnu lati ṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn ìṣàwárí wipe àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ jẹ́ àwọn ti oorun ńjẹníyà láàrin ọ̀sẹ̀.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, a professor of neurology at Harvard Medical School and director of the school's health care services, said the university decided to cancel the class after finding that students were predominantly from the night shift.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.

rows.source: ẹ̀kọ oni wákàtí gígùn ́náà ní oni àwọn ìmùṣẹ́ṣe oníṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé kan ninu.
rows.output: The new education system has a number of innovative features.
rows.reference: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.

rows.source: Ninu abala kan ni àwòrán tí yàrá kan ninu ibùgbé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan wa, níbití àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ńfọwọ́ ta àwọn ife kọfí, àwọn asọ ìbòju fèrèsé, àwọn akọ́nilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àwọn sọ fún wọn nípa àwọn ipa ti kafínìnnì àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti bí àìsí oorun tiṣe nla ipa lórí ìṣeṣí eré ìdárayá, àti pàtàkì níní àkókó ibùsùn tómọ́nilára.
rows.output: In a room, there is a picture of a room in a student's home, where students are pouring coffee cups, window curtains, and lecturing them about the effects of caffeine and light and how lack of sleep has a significant impact on athletic performance, and the importance of having a good night's sleep.
rows.reference: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.

rows.source: Ninu abala miran, àwọn akópa níwọ́n sọ fún nípa bí àìsí oorun onígbàtógùn ti leè mú àwọn ewu ti àwọn ìkọlù ọkàn, arọmọlápá-rọlẹ́sẹ̀, ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sí àti àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ pọ̀síi.
rows.output: In another study, the authors found that chronic sleep deprivation can increase the risk of heart attacks, arrhythmias, high blood pressure, and diabetes.
rows.reference: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.

rows.source: Àwòrán ọgbà ilé ìwé náà, pẹ̀lú àwọn àmi ìṣàmì ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀, lẹ́yìn náà ńṣekóríyá fún àwọn ìṣe ojoójúmọ tótidibárakú fún wọn.
rows.output: The photo of the school garden, with the symbols of friendship, is a reminder of the many wonderful memories they have made.
rows.reference: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.

rows.source: 'A mọ̀pé kòní yí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ padà' ninu ìwà wọn lójú-ẹṣẹ̀.
rows.output: We know that we are not turning the students back to their old ways.
rows.reference: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọ́n a gbàgbó wípé wọ́n ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti mọ̀ - gẹ́gẹ́bí ìwọ náà ti ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti mọ̀ àwọn ipa ti ìlera ti yíyàn láti máa mu àwọn sìgá,' ni Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler fi kún un.
rows.output: But we believe that they have the right to know - just as you have the right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke,' Professor Czeisler added.
rows.reference: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.

rows.source: Àṣà ti ìgbéraga ninu 'fífa gbogbo-olóru kan' sì wà síbẹ̀, ni ó sọ, tó sì ńfi kún un pé ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ tìgbàlódé àti ìnira tó ńpọ̀síi láìdúró lórí àwọn akẹ̵́kọ̀ọ́ túmọ̀ síipé ìfoorundunara-ẹni jẹ́ ìṣòro kan tó ńdàgbàsókè.
rows.output: The tradition of pride in 'doing a full lap' is still there, he said, and it is reinforced by the fact that modern technology and increasing pressure do not allow for any mistakes.
rows.reference: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.

rows.source: Ríríi dájú wípé ó rí oorun tópéye sùn, tósì dára kan, yẹ kí ó jẹ́ 'ohun ìjà ogun àṣírí' ti akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan láti gbógun ti ìnira-ọkàn, àárẹ̀, àti ìpayà, ni ó sọ - àni láti yàgò fún fífi ìwọn kún ìwọn títóbi ara-ẹni, nitoripe àìfójúlóoorun ńfi ọpọlọ náà sí ipò ebi, tósì ńjẹ́kí ebi máa pa wọ́n nígbà gbogbo.
rows.output: Ensuring that you get enough sleep, a good mattress, should be a 'weapon of mass comfort' for a student to fight off stress, anxiety, and depression, as it is said - even to avoid overthinking, because lack of sleep puts the brain in a state of hunger, and thus perpetuates hunger.
rows.reference: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.

rows.source: Raymond So, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlógún ara California kan tó ńkẹ̀kọ̀ọ́ nípa ìmọ̀ bàọ́lọ́jì tí èròjà kẹ́míkà àti nǹkan àfojúri, ràn Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn tí o ti kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ninu àwọn kíláàsì rẹ̀ ni ọdún àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ní Havard.
rows.output: Raymond So, a 19-year-old student from California who was studying the science of sleep, helped Professor Czeisler develop the course after taking his classes in his first year at Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.

rows.source: Ó sọpé ẹ̀kọ́ náà ti sí ojú òun tí ó sì ti fún òun ní ìmísí láti taari rẹ̀ fún ẹ̀kọ́ gbogbòò kan ninu ọgbà náà.
rows.output: He said that the education had opened his eyes and inspired him to pursue a general education in the garden.
rows.reference: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.

rows.source: Ìgbésẹ̀ tókàn náà, tó ńretí, ni láti bèèrè lọ́wọ́́ gbogbo àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tó ńkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gboye ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì láti parí ètò ẹ̀kọ́ tófarajọ́ ọ saáju kí wọ́n to ́darapọ̀ mọ́ ilé ìwé onífiga-gbága náà.
rows.output: The next step, which is expected, is to request all second-year students to complete their studies before joining the prestigious university.
rows.reference: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.

rows.source: Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler gba àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lámọ̀ràn wipe ki wọ́n ronú nipa ṣíṣètò aago ìtanijí kan láti sọ àkókò láti lọ sórí ibùsùn, àti ìgbà tóyẹ láti jí, àti kí wọn sì sọ́ra fun àwọn ipa tóléwuto 'ìtànsán ìmọlẹ̀ aláwọ̀ aró' tí àwọn ìbòjù ìwòran ńtú síta àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ LED, eyiti o leè da òbìrí iṣẹ́ àti oorun sísùn ojoójúmọ ẹni ru, tí yóò sì yọrídí àwọn ìṣòro àìrí-oorun sùn.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler advised students to consider setting a bedtime clock to indicate the time to go to bed, and the appropriate time to get up, and to be mindful of the effects of the 'blue light' emitted by computer screens and LEDs, which can interfere with the body's natural sleep-wake cycle, leading to sleep problems.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Bọ́ọ̀lù ti Menga gbá wọlé tẹ àwọn ọkùnrin Gerrard lọsílẹ̀
rows.output: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Bọọlu ti Menga gba wọle ṣaaju awọn ọkunrin Gerrard lọ silẹ.
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers jẹ ìyà àwọn ìkorò ti ọjọ-ìwàlájò miran bí ìkọlù-àìtàṣé ti Dolly Menga ti kó ikọ̀ ti Steven Gerrard aláìsínísọ̀kan sínú ìyà 1-0 kan ní Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers were the victims of another embarrassing defeat as Dolly Menga's own goal condemned Steven Gerrard's side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Ikọ̀ ti Ibrox náà ńwá láti ṣàkọsílẹ̀ ìborí àkọ́kọ́ wọn lójú ọ̀nà láti ìgbà ìborí 4-1 tíwọ́n ní ni St Johnstone ninu oṣù Ẹrẹ́ná, ṣùgbọ́n ikọ̀ ti Gary Holt ṣe wọ́nní ìpalára ìjìyà ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì tí Gerrard yóò ní ninu àwọn ìdíje méjìdínlógún gẹ́gẹ́bí olùṣàkóso láti fi àwọn kókó mẹ́jọ ti ikọ̀ rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ láìní àfojúsùn Hearts ikọ̀ Ladbrokes tíwọ́n jẹ́ adarí Líìgí Àkọ́kọ́.
rows.output: The Ibrox club is looking to record their first win on the road since their 4-1 defeat at St Johnstone in March, but Gary Holt's team are in danger of making it a second consecutive defeat for Gerrard in his 18th game as manager to leave his side eight points behind Hearts in the Ladbrokes Premiership.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga ṣe ọṣẹ́ àìtàṣe ní ìṣẹ́jú méje saájú ìdajì-àkókò tí ikọ̀ Rangers eyiti ó ṣe aláìní ìnísí kòfi ìgbà kankan wò rárá bí ẹnipé wọ́n fẹ́ báwọn dọ́gba.
rows.output: Menga made a free throw in seven minutes before halftime as the Rangers, who had never been in the lead, were unable to respond.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Nigbati Rangers jáwálẹ̀ báyìí sí ipò ìkẹfà, Livinston fò sí ipò ìkẹta tí wọn sìwà lẹ́yìn Hibernia nìkan lórí ìyàtọ̀ iye ayò gbígbá wọlé.
rows.output: When Rangers were relegated to sixth place, Livingston moved into third place and were only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Àtipé ìṣòro púpọ̀ síi sì leè wà ní ìpamọ́ fún Rangers lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n níláti tójú ọkùnrin tó ńkíyèsí ìlà orí-pápá Calum Spence fún ìpalára orí kan lẹ́yìn tí ó hàn wipe wọn ju ohun kan láti ìhà ibiti àwọn àlejò náà wà.
rows.output: The Rangers may have more problems in store after having to deal with a man who was observing the top shelf of Calum Spence for a head injury after he appeared to be hit by something from the direction of the visitors.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard ṣe àwọn ìyípadà mẹ́jọ sí ikọ̀ náà eyiti ó gbá rekọjá Ayr wọnú ìdíje tó kángun sí àṣèkágbá Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Betfred náà.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes to the team which drew with Ayr in the League One Betfred Cup match.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, ní apá miran, lọ pẹ̀lú Livi mọ́kànlá kannáà tí ó mú kókó kan kúró lára Hearts lọ́sẹ̀ tókọjá tí inú rẹ̀ kì bá sì dùn pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà tí àwọn ikọ̀ tótikọ́ dáradára rẹ̀ fi fún àwọn alátakò wọn lọ́rùn ní gbogbo ibiti wọ́n bá kọjú sí.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, was with Livio eleven times, taking a penalty from Hearts last week, and he was not happy with the way the referee treated the opposing team in every situation they encountered.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Rangers leè ti ní àwọn bọ́ọ̀lù pípẹ́lẹ́sẹ̀ tópọ̀jùlọ̀ ṣùgbọ́n Livingston ṣe púpọ̀ pẹ̀lú bọ́ọ̀lù náà tíwọ́n ní.
rows.output: The Rangers may not have had the most prolific squad, but Livingston had a lot of the ball and they had a lot of the possession.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ó yẹ kíwọ́n ti gbá ayò wọlé ní ìṣẹ́jú méji nigbati  bọ́ọ̀lù aláàtẹ́sílẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ ti Menga rán Scott níṣẹ́ wọ ojú ile Allan McGregor ṣùgbọ́n tí onípò-ààrin náà gbá àǹfààní ńlá rẹ̀ dànù sígbó.
rows.output: He should have brought the ball in two minutes when the first shot of the game by Menga was saved by Allan McGregor, but the midfielder squandered a great chance to score.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Ìgbásójú-ilé aláìsí-àtakò tójinlẹ̀ ti Keaghan Jacobs lẹ́yìn náà rí asíwáju Craig Halkett ṣùgbọ́n akẹgbẹ́ aláàbò rẹ̀ Alan Lithgow kàn leè  gúnbẹ dànù ní ẹ̀yìn ojú-ilé náà.
rows.output: The subsequent goal by Keaghan Jacobs was followed by a header from Craig Halkett, but his teammate, the goalkeeper Alan Lithgow, was unable to stop the shot.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers kúkú já ìṣàkóso gbà ṣùgbọ́n ó dàbí ẹnipé ìrètí púpọ̀ wà ju ìgbàgbọ́ nípa ayò gbígbá wọn ninu ìparí ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kẹta náà.
rows.output: The Rangers were knocked out of the competition, but it seemed that there was more hope than belief in their ability to win the third-place playoff.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos rò pẹ̀lú ìdánilójú wipe ó yẹ́ki òun gba pẹnariti gbígbá kan lójú àmì ìdá kan nínú ìdá mẹ́rin wákàtí bí òun àti Steven Lawless tíkọlu ara wọn ṣùgbọ́n rẹfirí Steven Thomson juwọ́ dànù sí àwọn ẹ̀bẹ̀ ọmọ ilẹ Colombia náà.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos was confident that he deserved a penalty after being fouled in the box in the 74th minute, as he and Steven Lawless collided, but he referred to Steven Thomson as the one who missed the Colombian player's chances.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers rí ọgbọ́n dá láti gba àwọn bọ́ọ̀lù gbígbóná méjì tólọ sójú ilé ni ìdajì ìdíje àkọ́kọ́ ṣùgbọ́n aṣọ́lé Ibrox Liam Kelly kòfi bẹ́ẹ̀ rí ìsọro rárá nípaṣẹ̀ bọ́ọ̀lù aforígbá ti Lassana Coulibaly àti ìkọlù Ovie Ejaria tíwọn mú ṣo.
rows.output: The Rangers were awarded two soft penalties in the first half but Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was helpless to prevent Lassana Coulibaly's header and Ovie Ejaria's strike.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Nigbati bọ́ọ̀lù àfisíde tówọlé ti Livi leè jẹ́ eyiti tólòdì sí bí ìdíje tí ńlọ, kòsí ẹnití o leè ṣẹ́ wipe wọn yẹ fún un nitori ohun tíwọ́n gbà nìkan.
rows.output: When Livi's ball is deflected, it is not always easy to say who is to blame, as they are only responsible for their own actions.
rows.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

rows.source: Lẹ́ẹ̀kan sii Rangers kùná láti yanjú ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú àtòpapọ̀-ẹlẹ́yọ tójinlẹ̀ kan.
rows.output: Once again Rangers were unable to solve a problem with a two-goal lead.
rows.reference: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.

rows.source: Scott Arfield kò dáhùn bí Declan Gallagher ti taari bọ́ọ̀lù sí Scott Robinson ẹnití ó farabalẹ̀  láti yọ Menga jáde fún ìparí tó rọrùn kan.
rows.output: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher headed the ball to Scott Robinson, who calmly cleared Menga for a simple finish.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.

rows.source: Gerrard ṣe nǹkan ninu ìsinmi náà bí ó ti pààrọ̀ Coulibaly fún Ryan Kent ti ìyípadà náà sì fẹ́rẹ̀ pèsè ipa kan lójú-ẹṣẹ̀ bí onípò-igun náà ti gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sínú fún Morelos ṣùgbọn Kelly tó móríẹni wú sáré kuro lójú ìlà rẹ̀ láti dènà.
rows.output: Gerrard was involved in the break, as he replaced Coulibaly for Ryan Kent, whose substitution almost provided an instant impact as the winger curled a shot just wide for Morelos, but Kelly, who had been solid, sprinted across to block the shot.
rows.reference: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọn Livinston tẹ̀síwájú láti fa àwọn àlejò náà sí gbígbá ayò lọ́nà ìdíje náà tíwọ́n gbádùn, pẹ̀lú Lithgow àti Halkett tíwọ́n ńgbá bọ́ọ̀lù gígùn lẹ́yìn bọ́ọ̀lù gígùn.
rows.output: However, Livingston continued to lure the guests to the dance floor in a competitive manner, with Lithgow and Halkett competing in a long shot race after the long shot.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Ikọ̀ Holt kòbá ti fa ìléwájú wọn wọnú àwọn ipele ìparí ṣùgbọn McGregor duro dìde bótiyẹ láti fí ayò dun Jacobs kí Lithgow tó fi orí gbá a dànù láti igun náà.
rows.output: Holt's attack did not push the enemy into the final phase, but McGregor stood up and made the air resound with his voice, and Lithgow struck him down from the side.
rows.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

rows.source: Àfirọ́pò Rangers Glenn Middleton ni àwíjàre ìgbẹ̀yìn miran fún pẹnariti gbígbá bí o ti lọ́ mọ́ Jacobs ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́èkan síi Thomsom wo ibòmíràn.
rows.output: Rangers replacement Glenn Middleton is another option for the left back as he continues to impress Jacobs but again Thomson looks elsewhere.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.source: Álimánáàkì Aṣàgbélẹ̀rọ́ ti Olóǹka Geiger náà
rows.output: The Geiger Counter Specialist
rows.reference: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter

rows.source: Àtipé nísinsìnyí ojú-ewé kan kúrò sí Álimánáàkì ''Sunday Morning'' wa: Ní Ọgbọ̀nọjọ́ oṣù Owewe, lọ́dún 1882, lọ́dún mẹ̵́rìndínlógóje lóòní, tósì tún ŃKA... ọjọ́ náà ni wọ́n bí onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ ohun àfojúrí ọjọ́ iwájú Johannes Wilhelm ''Hans'' Geiger ní orilẹ-ede Jamani.
rows.output: Now, a page is removed from the book of "Sunday Morning" by Almanac: On the 30th of August, 1882, in the year of our Lord 1882, still in the 19th century... the day was the birth of future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger in the German Empire.
rows.reference: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.

rows.source: Geiger ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ọgbọ́n-àtiṣenǹkan fún dídámọ̀ àti ṣíṣe òdiwọ̀n àwọn ìtújáde tíwọn pè ni oníṣẹ́rédíò, àgbélẹ̀rọ eyiti o pàpà yọrísì ẹ̀rọ náà tíwọ́n mọ̀ sí Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger developed a method for measuring and limiting the effects of their own radiation, which they called the "Geiger counter," an instrument that they named after themselves.
rows.reference: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.

rows.source: Òpómúléró kan ti ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti ìgbà náà, Olóǹkà Geiger di òpó fún àṣà pop bákannáà, bótirí ninu àwòrán sinnimá ọdún 1950 ''Àwọn Agogo ti Colorado,'' eyiti àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì tíwọn fúnníṣe àgbàṣe wọ̀nyẹn tí a kò lérò ROY Rogers àti Dale Evans ti kópa:
rows.output: A scientist of the time, the physicist Hans Geiger, also became a pop icon, thanks to his appearance in the 1950 film "The Atomic City," in which the scientists (played by Roy Rogers and Dale Evans) used his invention, the Geiger counter.
rows.reference: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:

rows.output: Rogers: "A Geiger counter is, which they use to determine the location of radioactive elements, such as uranium."

rows.output: The method of action involves finding cancer stem cells that have escaped from a patient's body, and then transforming them into a laboratory cell culture so that they can be 'seen' to contain a high concentration of a particular protein called HER2, and then re-introducing the cells into the patient's body.
rows.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

rows.output: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our findings tell us that we have a highly effective anti-inflammatory drug.

rows.output: HER2 is associated with the development of a number of different types of cancer, including ovarian, breast, lung, and esophageal cancer, as explained by Professor Berzofsky.
rows.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

rows.reference: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.

rows.source: Akọrinbíẹnití-ń-sọ̀rọ̀ bí tirẹ̀, Snoop Dogg ti ní orúkọ Snoop Lion àtipe bí a ti ńretí àgbà akọrin tódi olóògbé Prince, yí orúkọ rẹ̵̀ padà sí àmì kan àtipé lẹ́yìn náà òṣèré tíwọn mọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ bíi Prince.
rows.output: Snoop Dogg, who has always been known as Snoop Dogg, has taken on the name Snoop Lion and is expected to be a legendary musician, similar to the late musician Prince, who changed his name to a symbol and then an actor known as Prince.
rows.reference: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.

rows.source: Ẹ̀sùn ìgbìyànjú láti pànìyàn nitori ìgúnnilọ́bẹ nílé oúnjẹ
rows.output: Attempted murder due to a dispute in a restaurant
rows.reference: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing

rows.source: Ọkùnrin ẹni ọdún márùndínláàdọ́ta kan ní wọ́n ti fẹ̀sùn ìgbìyànjú láti pànìyàn kàn lẹ́yìn tíwọ́n gún ọkùnrin kan lọ́bẹ nílé oúnjẹ kan ní ìlà-oòrùn Belfast lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì.
rows.output: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in the back at a restaurant in east Belfast on Thursday.
rows.reference: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.

rows.source: Olọ́ọ̀pá sowipe ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà wáyé ni Ballyhackamore.
rows.output: The police said the incident occurred in Ballyhackamore.
rows.reference: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.

rows.source: Ẹnití wọn fẹ̀sùn kàn náà níwọn ńretí láti farahàn níwájú Ilé Ẹjọ́ Majisireti ti Belfast lọ́jọ́ Ajé.
rows.output: The person who made the complaint was expected to appear before the Magistrates' Court in Belfast on Monday.
rows.reference: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.

rows.source: Àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà ni wọ́n yóò tún ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò wọn láti ọwọ́ Ilé Iṣẹ́ Ìgbẹ́jọ́ ti Ara Ìlú.
rows.output: The charges will be re-examined by the City's Public Prosecution Department.
rows.reference: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.

rows.source: Ìràwọ Games of Thrones Kit Harrington sọ̀rọ̀ burúku jáde sí ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró
rows.output: Kit Harington, star of Game of Thrones, spoke candidly about his struggles with depression
rows.reference: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity

rows.source: Kit Harrington níwọ́n mọ̀ fún ipa tókó bíi Jon Snow tó ńfi idà sọ́ọ̀tún àti sósì ninu eré ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé aláàlá ti ààrin ìgbà tósaáju ayé ọ̀lájú Games of Thrones.
rows.output: Kit Harington is best known for his role as Jon Snow in the fantasy television series Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọ́n òṣèré náà, ẹni ọdún mọ́kànlélọ́gbọ̀n, ti sọ̀rọ̀ burúkú àwọn tóńṣe bí akọni ọkùnrin náà, tó sì ńs̵ọpé irú àwọn ipa bẹ́ẹ̀ lójú ìbòjú túmọ̀sí pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin máa ńrò lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà wipe àwọn níláti jẹ́ ẹniti o le koko kí wọ́n tó leè bọ̀wọ̀ fún wọn.
rows.output: But the actor, who is 31 years old, has spoken out against the portrayal of male heroes, saying that such roles on screen mean that young men often feel they have to be tough in order to be respected.
rows.reference: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.

rows.source: Nígbátí ó ńbá The Sunday Times Culture, Kit sọpé òun gbàgbọ́ wipe 'ohun kan ti mẹ̀hẹ' tí ó sì béèrè bí wọ́n ti ṣe leè kojú ìṣòro ti ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró náà ninu ìgbà #Me Too Erà.
rows.output: When she met The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said she believed that "something had changed" and asked how they had dealt with the problem of sexual harassment in the #MeToo era.
rows.reference: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.

rows.source: Kit, ẹnití ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ṣe ìgbéyàwó pẹ̀lú ìràwọ akẹgbẹ́ rẹ̵̀ ninu Games of Thrones Rose Leslie, ẹnití òun náà jẹ́ ẹni ọdún mọ́kànlélọ́gbọ̀n, gbà wipe òun náà rò 'lọ́nà tólágbára gidi' nípa mímójútó ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
rows.output: Kit, who recently married his co-star from Game of Thrones Rose Leslie, who is also 32, said he was "really nervous" about proposing.
rows.reference: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.

rows.source: Ó sope ̣.'Mo rò gidigidi nítèmi, lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìi pé - níbo ni a ti ṣe àṣ̀iṣe pẹ̵̀lú ìṣebí-ọkùnrin?’.
rows.output: He said, "I'm really confused, right now, about - where did we go wrong with the relationship?"
rows.reference: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.

rows.source: 'Kínni a ti ńkọ́ àwọn ọkùnrin nigbati wọ́n ńdàgbàsókè, nípa ì̀ṣòró nàà tí a rí nísinsìnyí?'
rows.output: What are we teaching our boys as they grow up, about the challenge that we now see?
rows.reference: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'

rows.source: Kit gbàgbọ́ wipe ó ṣeé ṣe kí ẹ̀rọ amóhùnmáwòrán jẹ́ okùnfà lápá kàn fún pípọ̀síi ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró ọpẹ́ ni fún un nítorí àwọn àbùdá ọkùnrin rẹ̀.
rows.output: He believed that the television was the only source of male companionship that was available to him because of his male characteristics.
rows.reference: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.

rows.source: Ó tẹ̀síwájú: Kínni ohun tí a bímọ́ni àtipé kínni a kọ́ni?
rows.output: He continued: What are we born to do and what are we born to know?
rows.reference: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?

rows.source: Ohun tí a kọ́ni lóri ẹrọ ámóhὺnmáwòran, àti ní àwọn òpópóna, eyiti ó ńjẹ́ kí àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin máa lérò wipe àwọn níláti jẹ́ apá kan tódájú ti jíjẹ́ ọkùnrin?
rows.output: The things we learn from the media, and in the streets, which make young people think that they have to be a part of the act of being a man?
rows.reference: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?

rows.source: Mo ròpé ìyẹn gan-an ni ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ìbéèrè ńlá ní àkókò tiwa - báwo ni a ó ṣe yí ìyẹn padà?
rows.output: I think that's one of the big questions of our time - how do we turn that around?
rows.reference: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?

rows.source: Nitoripe ní kedere ohun ti o mẹ́hẹ̀ fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùrin.'
rows.output: Because in truth, it is a matter of life and death for the young people.
rows.reference: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'

rows.source: Ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò náà o tún gbà wipe òun kòní ṣe èyíkéyìí àwọn àṣesíwáju tàbí àwọn àtẹ̀lé Game of Thrones nigbati ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé náà bá wá sópin ní ìparí ìgbà ooru tókàn, tí ó ńsọpé òun ti 'ṣetán pẹ̀lú àwọn pápá ogun jíjà àti àwọn ẹsin'.
rows.output: In the interview, he also stated that he did not have any of the Game of Thrones spinoffs or sequels in the works when the show ended, saying that he was "just enjoying the battlefields and the churches."
rows.reference: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.

rows.source: Láti oṣù Bélú Kit yóò máa jẹ́ ìràwọ ninu ìsọjí ti True West láti ọwọ́ Sam Shepard eyiti i ṣe ìtàn ti aṣàgbéjáde sinnimá àti arákùnrin rẹ̀, ẹniti o jẹ́ olè.
rows.output: From the beginning of November, Kit will be the star in the play True West by Sam Shepard, which tells the story of a screenwriter and his brother, who is a thief.
rows.reference: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.

rows.source: Òṣèré náà sí ọ̀rọ̀ náà payá láìpẹ́ wipe òun ńròpé pípàdé aya òun Rose lójẹ́ ohun tòdára jùlọ láti jáde síta láti inú Game of Thrones.
rows.output: The actor revealed in a recent interview that he believed meeting his wife Rose was the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.

rows.source: Ó s̵ọpé 'Mo pàde aya mi ninu ètò yìì, nípasè́ ọ̀nà yii ó fún mi ní ìdílé ọjọ́ ọ̀la mi, àti ayé mi láti ibí losi iwaju’
rows.output: He said, "I found my wife in this program, through this way it gave me my future family, and my life from there on."
rows.reference: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.

rows.source: Rose ṣe bíi Ygritte, ìfẹ́ tówuni náà ti ìkópa Kit Jon Snow, ninu ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé aláàlá náà eyiti ó gba àmì-ìdálọ́lá ti Emmy.
rows.output: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Jon Snow, in the hit HBO series Game of Thrones, which won the Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series.
rows.reference: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.

rows.source: Tọkọtaya náà ṣe ìgbéyàwó ní oṣù Òkúdu lọ́dún 2018 lórí ilẹ̀ agbo-ilé ńlá ti ìdíle Leslie ní Sikọtilandi.
rows.output: The couple married in October 2018 on the large family farm of Leslie in Scotland.
rows.reference: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.

rows.source: Ààrùn HIV/Aids: Orilẹ̵-ede Ṣáínà ròyìn ìlọsókè ìdá mẹ́rìnlá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ninu àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun
rows.output: HIV/AIDS: China reports a 14% increase in the number of new cases
rows.reference: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases

rows.source: Orilẹ̵-ede Ṣáínà ti kéde ìfòsókè ìdá mẹ́rìnlá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ninu iye àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ náà tíwọ́n ńgbé pẹ̀lú ààrùn HIV àti Aids.
rows.output: China has announced a 14% reduction in the number of its citizens living with HIV/AIDS.
rows.reference: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.

rows.source: Àwọn eniyan tólé ní ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà okòólélẹ̀gbẹrin ní wọn ni ààrun náà ní orilẹ-èdè náà, ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ètò ìlera sọ.
rows.output: More than 300,000 people in the country have been infected with the virus, according to health officials.
rows.reference: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.

rows.source: Bíi ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ogójì àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun ni wọ́n ròyìn rẹ̀ ninu kọ́tà ìkejì ti ọdún 2018 nìkan.
rows.output: More than 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.reference: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.

rows.source: Ọ̀pọ̀ ninu àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun náà níwọn kó nípaṣẹ̀ ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀, eyiti ó ńṣàmì ìyípadà  kúrò ní tàtijọ́ náà.
rows.output: Many of the new events are related to the relationship, which is changing from the old one.
rows.reference: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.

rows.source: Níti ìṣe tí a mọ̀, HIV ńtàn kálẹ̀ ní kíakía ní àwọn apá orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà kan nítorí àwọn ìfẹ̀jẹ̀tóníkòkòrò ààrùn sínilára.
rows.output: In practice, HIV is spreading rapidly in some parts of China due to the lack of awareness of the disease.
rows.reference: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọn iye àwọn eniyan tó ńkó ààrùn HIV lọ́nà yìí ni wọ́n ti dínkù sí bíi òdo, ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ètò ìlera orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà sọ níbi àpérò kan ni ẹkùn Yunnan.
rows.output: However, the number of people living with HIV in this way has decreased to a trickle, according to Chinese health officials at a conference in the southern province of Yunnan.
rows.reference: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.

rows.source: Láti ọdún-dé-ọdún, botiwukori, iye àwọn tíwọn ńgbé pẹ̀lú kòkòrò ààrùn HIV àti Aids lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ti lọ sókè síi nípa ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ọgọ́ọ̀rún eniyan.
rows.output: Every year, the number of people living with HIV and AIDS in China has increased by hundreds of thousands of people.
rows.reference: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.

rows.source: Títaǹkalẹ̀ ààrùn HIV nípa ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀ jẹ ọrọ tóṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ láàrin àwùjọ ti LGBT lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà.
rows.output: The spread of HIV through sexual contact is a major issue among the LGBT community in China.
rows.reference: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.

rows.source: Ìwà kí ọkùnrin máa bá ọkùnrin lòpọ̀ ni wọ́n ti yọ kúrò ninu ìwà ọ̀daràn lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà lọ́dún 1997, ṣùgbọ́n ìwà dídẹ́yẹsí àwọn eniyan LGBT ni wọn sọpé ó sìpọ̀.
rows.output: The legal recognition of same-sex marriage was removed from the Chinese Criminal Code in 1997, but the persecution of LGBT people is still said to continue.
rows.reference: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.

rows.source: Nitori ìwà àifààyègba-ìyípadà orilẹ-ede náà, àwọn ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ṣe àfojúda wipe ìdà àádọrin sí àádọ́ọ̀rún ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n ńbá àwọn ọkùnrin lòpọ̀ ni wọn yóò gbé àwọn obìnrin níyàwo nígbẹ̀yìn.
rows.output: Due to the country's conservative nature, studies have shown that 70 to 80 percent of men who have sex with men will marry women eventually.
rows.reference: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.

rows.source: Ọ̀pọ̀ ninu àwọn ọ̀nà ìtànkálẹ̀ ààrùn náà ńwá láti inú àwọn àìtó ìdáààbòbò ara ẹni nígbà ìbálòpọ̀ ninu àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ wọ̀nyí.
rows.output: Most of the transmission routes of the disease are from unprotected sexual contact in these relationships.
rows.reference: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.

rows.source: Láti ọdún 2003, ni ìjọba orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ti ṣè ìlérí ìráyèsí tókáríayé sí àwọn òògùn ààrun HIV gẹ́gẹ́bí ara ìgbìyànjú kan láti dójukọ ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
rows.output: Since 2003, the Chinese government has pledged to provide free antiretroviral drugs to all AIDS patients.
rows.reference: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.

rows.source: Maxine Walter ńṣẹ́ wipe òṣìṣẹ́ kan ló tú àṣírí àkọsílẹ̀ dátà àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú GOP, ó sọ̀rọ̀ burúkú sí 'àwọn irọ́ tóléwu' àti 'àwọn ìrònútófẹ́di-òtítọ́ wípé ọ̀tẹ̀ wà'
rows.output: Maxine Walter claims that a staff member leaked the data records of the top Republican lawmakers, saying that they are "telling lies" and "making up facts to fit their narrative."
rows.reference: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'

rows.source: Orilẹ-ede U.S. Aṣojú-ṣòfin kékeré Maxine Walters lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta kọ̀ jálẹ̀ lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn wipe ọ̀kan ninu àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ti ṣàgbéjáde àwọn ìwífúnni ti ara ẹni ti àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican mẹ́ta ti  orilẹ-ede U.S. sínu àwọn ojú-ewé Wikipedia ti àwọn àṣofin náà.
rows.output: On Wednesday, U.S. Rep. Maxine Walters, a Democrat, accused one of her staff members of leaking personal information of three Republican U.S. lawmakers to Wikipedia.
rows.reference: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.

rows.source: Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrat ní Los Angeles tẹnumọ́ ọn wipe àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà níwọ́n ńwá kẹ̀kẹ́ rẹ̀ láti ọwọ́ àwọn onímọ̀ àti àwọn ojú-òpó ti ''òṣèlú ọlọ́wọ́-ọ̀tún''.
rows.output: A Democratic Party member in Los Angeles emphasized that the accusations are coming from the "far right" of the party.
rows.reference: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.

rows.source: ''Àwọn irọ́, àwọn irọ́, àti àwọn irọ́ tíkòwúlò,'' ni Walters sọ ninu gbólóhùn kan lórí Twitter.
rows.output: "Falsehoods, lies, and fake news are all the same," Walters said in a tweet.
rows.reference: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.

rows.source: Ìwífúnni náà ni ìròyìn sọpé ó ní àwọn àdírẹ́sì àti àwọn nọmba ẹẹrọ ìbànisϙrϙ fún orilẹ-ede U.S. nínú. Àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà Lindsey Graham ti Gúúsú Carolina, àti Mike Lee àti Orrin Hatch, méjèèjì ti Utah.
rows.output: The announcement is reported to include contact information and phone numbers for the U.S.
rows.reference: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.

rows.source: Ìwífúnni náà farahàn lórí ojú-òpò ayelujara lọ́jọ́ 'Ru, tí ẹnìkan tíwọ́n kòmọ̀ sàgbéjáde rẹ̀ lórí Capitol Hill nígbà ìgbẹ́jọ́ ìgbìmọ ti Àwọn Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà kan lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìwàkiwà ti ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀ tíwọ́n fi kan ẹnití wọ́n fàkalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ ní Ilé Ẹjọ́ Tógajùlọ Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: The announcement appeared on the internet on the day of the hearing before the Senate Judiciary Committee on allegations of sexual misconduct against the nominee for the Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Àṣìrí náà tú lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà  mẹ́ta náà ti Kavanaugh ní àwọn ìbéèrè.
rows.output: The vote was taken after the three senior lawmakers questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Àwọn ojú-òpò ayelujara ti àwọn òṣèlu tí kìí fààyègba-ìyípadà bíi Gateway Pundit RedState ròyìn wipe àdírẹ́sì IP náà eyiti ó ńdá orísun àwọn àgbéjáde náà mọ̀ ní wọ́n ní àjọṣe pẹ̀lú ọ́fíìsì Waters tí o sì tú ìwífúnni ti ọ̀kan ninu àwọn òsìṣẹ́ Waters kan sílẹ̀, ni The Hill sọ níhú l̀ròyìn rẹ̀.
rows.output: Online news outlets like Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identified the source of the leaks was linked to Waters' office and released information about one of Waters' employees, according to a report in The Hill.
rows.reference: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.

rows.source: ''Ẹ̀sùn yìí jẹ eyiti kò fẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ní gbogbo ọ̀nà àtipé irọ́ pátápátá kan ni,'' Waters tẹ̀síwájú.
rows.output: "This accusation is unfounded in every way and is simply a false claim," Waters continued.
rows.reference: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.

rows.source: ''Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mi - ẹnití ìdánimọ̀, ìwìfúnni ti ara-ẹni, àti ààbò rẹ̀ leè ti di eyiti ó ti gbọ̀jẹ̀gẹ́ nitori àwọn ẹ̀sùn oníjìbìtí ati irọ́ - lọ́nàkọ́nà kìi ṣe ẹnití ó ṣe okùnfà títú ìwífúnni yìí síta.
rows.output: The member of my staff - who is identified, self-disclosed, and protected - may have been the one who was accused of leaking this information.
rows.reference: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.

rows.source: 'Ẹ̀sùn ti kòfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ yìí ní gbogbo ọ̀nà jẹ eyiti ó jìnnà sí òtítọ àtipé irọ́ pátápátá ni.''
rows.output: This accusation is completely unfounded and has no basis in fact.
rows.reference: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."

rows.source: Gbólóhùn Walters fa ìbẹnuàtẹ́síni ní kíákíá láti ojú-òpó ayelujara, àti láti ọ̀dọ̀ akọ̀wé ìròyìn ilé ìjọba White House tẹ́lẹ̀rí Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Walters' statement sparked a flurry of comments on the internet, and from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: ''Kíkọ̀jálẹ̀ yìí ńbínu,'' ni Fleischer kọsí ìwé.
rows.output: This is a very serious matter, Fleischer wrote in his diary.
rows.reference: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.

rows.source: Èyí ńsọpe kòní ìṣeṣí ti ìrònú láti jẹ́ Ọmọ Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Kékeré.
rows.output: This is a call for the exercise of the right to be a Member of the House of Representatives.
rows.reference: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.

rows.source: Nigbati a báfi ẹ̀sùn kan ẹnìkan nípa ohun tí wọn kòṣe, wọn kò gbọdọ̀ bínú.
rows.output: When you accuse someone of something they didn't do, you should not be angry.
rows.reference: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.

rows.source: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ jẹ́ olórikunkun.
rows.output: They must not be a tyrant.
rows.reference: They must not be defiant.

rows.source: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ máa béère àwọn èrèdí ti olùfisùn náà.
rows.output: They must not demand the rewards of the presenter.
rows.reference: They must not question the motives of the accuser.

rows.source: Wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ farabalẹ̀ kí wọ́n sì dákẹ́jẹ́jẹ́.''
rows.output: They must be patient and persistent.
rows.reference: They must be calm and serene."

rows.source: Fleischer ńfarahàn láti ṣe àfiwé ìdáhùn Waters sí ìbẹnuàtẹluni tí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrat ṣe sí Adájọ́ Kavanaugh, ẹnití àwọn abẹnuàtẹluni fẹ̀sùn kàn wipe ó dàbí ẹnipé ó ńbínú púpọ̀ jù nígbà ìgbẹ́jọ́ lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀.
rows.output: Fleischer appears to draw a comparison between Waters' response to the Democrats' boycott of Justice Kavanaugh, who was accused of being too emotional during his confirmation hearing on "Bọ.
rows.reference: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, olùdíje ẹgbẹ́ Republican kan tó ńdíje láti yẹ àga mọ́ Waters ní ìdí ninu àwọn ìdìbò ààrin-sáà náà, bákannáà sọ àwọn èrò ọkàn rẹ̀ jáde lori Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running against Waters in the November election, also shared his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.

rows.source: ''Ó tóbi bí ó bájẹ́ òtítọ́, ní àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tuwiti tí o kọ.
rows.output: "It's as big as the truth, the tweet you wrote."
rows.reference: "Big if true," he tweeted.

rows.source: Ninu gbólóhùn rẹ̀, Waters sọpé ọ́fíìsì òun ti ṣe ìtanilóbo fún ''àwọn aláṣẹ tóyẹ àti àwọn ẹ̀ka agbófinró nípa àwọn ẹ̀sùn oníjìbìtì wọ̀nyí.
rows.output: In his statement, Waters said that his office had been in contact with "responsible authorities and law enforcement agencies about these allegations."
rows.reference: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.

rows.source: ''A ó ríi dájú wipe wọn fi àwọn tóṣiṣẹ́ náà hàn,'' ó tẹ̀síwájú, ''àtipe wọ́n mú wọn dáhùn nípa ti òfin fún gbogbo ohun tíwọ́n ṣe eyiti o leè ba nǹkan tí ò sì tún léwu fún gbogbo àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mi.''
rows.output: "We will make sure that the workers are held accountable," he continued, "and that they are punished according to the law for everything they have done, which could also be dangerous for all my workers."
rows.reference: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."

rows.source: Àtúngbéyẹ̀wò Àwọn Ìkọlu Àìtàṣé ti Johnny English - sọ ẹ̀gàn alamí Rowan Atkinson di aláìlágbára
rows.output: Review of Johnny English Unchained - the slapstick humor of Rowan Atkinson is now too forced
rows.reference: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof

rows.source: O tí di àṣà báyìí láti máa fojú wa àwọn ìṣepàtàki Brexit ninu èyíkéyìí sinnima tuntun tí ó ní ọ̀rọ̀ èébú ti èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sìti ìyẹn sì dàbí pé ó ṣ̵̵eé múlò fún ìsọjí ti àṣẹ-ìtaja ẹ̀gàn fún eré  aláwàdà-oníṣegírí ti Johnny English - eyiti o bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́dún 2003 ţí ó sì tún padà s'áyé lọ́dún 2011 pẹ̀lú Àtúnbi Johnny English.
rows.output: It has become customary to ignore the importance of Brexit in any new film with a British accent, and it seems to be a deliberate attempt to undermine the authority of the trade agreement for a comedy of errors film, Johnny English - which began in 2003 and was revived in 2011 with the sequel Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Ǹjẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ìfọgbọ́nbúraẹni léèébu apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín lórí àkòrí bí a tiṣe ya ọ̀pọ̀ aláìníyelórí tó pẹ̀lu pé a ńjẹ ànfààní tuntun ìkó-ọjàjádesíta ti orilẹ̵-ede?
rows.output: Is the issue of self-censorship on the topic of the new national security law a matter of concern?
rows.reference: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?

rows.source: Ní gbogbo ọ̀nà, ẹlẹ́yinjú-ńlá, olójú-rọ́bà aláìkójú-ìwọ̀n Johnny English ti tún ṣọ ìwé-àṣẹ rẹ̀ dọ̀tun láti máaṣe nǹkan lọ́nà burúkú fún ìgbà kejì -  orúkọ tirẹ̀ yẹn tó ńfihàn ju ohunkohun lọ wipe ó jẹ́ ìṣẹ̀dá aláwàdà kan tí a ṣẹ̀dá fún àwọn tó ńlọ síbi sinnimá ní àwọn ilẹ̀ tíwọn kìí sọ èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
rows.output: In every way, the clumsy, awkward Johnny English has once again rewritten his own rulebook to make things worse for the second time - his own name, which is more revealing than anything else that he is a comedic creation made for people going to the cinema in non-English speaking countries.
rows.reference: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.

rows.source: Òun ni bí a ti ńretí òpònú ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ́ alami náà ẹnití o jẹ́pé láìka àwọn ẹ̀tàn tóyaṣa rẹ̀ afẹfẹ yẹ̀yẹ̀ aláìlójúrere rẹ̀ sí ti ni kékeré ti Clouseau, bíńtín ti Mr Bean ati ìwọn díẹ̀ ti ẹni yẹn ti fi àkíyèsí kan ṣoṣo sí orin àkọmọ̀nà ti Chariots of Fire níbi ayẹyẹ sísí ìdíje Olympics lọ́dún 2012 ní Lọndọnu.
rows.output: He was the expected heir to the throne of the legendary kingdom of Almayer, who, despite his many dubious dealings, was a man of great honor and integrity, a small but significant part of Clouseau, the son of Mr. Bean, and a tiny bit of that guy who only had one interest in the original soundtrack of Chariots of Fire at the London Olympics in 2012.
rows.reference: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.

rows.source: Òun tún ni ẹnitójẹ ojúlówo ní idúró lóri ọkùnrin àdììtú arìnrìn-àjò àti ti àgbáyé Atkinson tí wọn ṣe eré rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ ninu àwọn ìpolówó Barclaycard tíwọ́n ti gbàgbé báyìí, eyiti ó fi ìdàrúdàpọ̀ sílẹ̀ lẹ́yìn rẹ̀.
rows.output: He is also the face of the new campaign for Barclaycard, which features a parody of the classic "Barclaycard" jingle.
rows.reference: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.

rows.source: Àwọn àkókò tódára kan tàbi méjì wá ninu JE tuntun tóṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ jáde yìí.
rows.output: Some interesting times are coming in the new JE edition.
rows.reference: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.

rows.source: Mo fẹ́ràn Johnny English bóti ńsúnmọ́ ọkọ òfurufú hẹlikoputa nigbati ó wọ kóòtù àtijọ́ ti ìhámọ́ra irin tí àwọn abẹ sí pariwo lòdì sí àsíborí rẹ̀.
rows.output: I love Johnny English so much as he is approaching the helicopter when he is wearing a vintage leather jacket that the hangers are screaming against his shoulder.
rows.reference: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.

rows.source: Ẹ̀bùn Atkinson fún àwàdà àfojúrí wà lórí àfihàn, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀fẹ̀ náà dàbí aláìlágbárá àti eyiti kò wúlò papàá bí àwọn olórúkọ sinnimá ''gidi'' náà bíi 007 àti Mission Impossible fúnrawọn ti ńfi ìgboyà fúnni ní àwàdà bí èròja kan.
rows.output: Atkinson's award for best comedy is on the line, but the joke is flat and useless, especially when compared to the more confident comedy of the "real" movie stars like 007 and Mission Impossible.
rows.reference: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.

rows.source: Ẹ̀fẹ náà dàbí pé wọ́n jú u sọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé jú ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn àgbàlagbà, àtipé fún èmi ìrìnkerindò àìtọ́ tí òmùgọ̀ Johnny English kòní àgbéjáde àti àfojúsùn bíi tí àwọn aláwàdà oníìdákẹ́jẹ́ sinnimá ninu àwọ̀n òṣère ti Bean.
rows.output: The villain seemed to be a young man in the presence of children, and I, a clumsy and foolish Johnny English, was not worthy of the attention of the great and serious actors in the Bean film.
rows.reference: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.

rows.source: Gbólóhùn ọ̀rọ̀ náà tó ńlọ lọ́wọ́ láti ìgbà dé ìgbà nipé orilẹ̵-ede Great Britain wà ninu ìyọnu gidigidi.
rows.output: The current situation is that the British Empire is in a state of decline.
rows.reference: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.

rows.source: Onímọ-kọ̀m̀pútà ajíniníròyìn kan ti rápálá wọ inú oju-òpó ìtàkùn àṣírí-alágbára ti àwọn amì orilẹ-ede Britain, tó sì ńfi àwọn ìdánimọ̀ tí gbogbo àwọn ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ ninu iṣẹ́ náà, sí ìyàlẹ́nu ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ náà tówà lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ - ojúṣe aláàbámọ̀ kékeré kan fún Kevin Eldon.
rows.output: A computer programmer accidentally enters the secret code of the British national anthem, and is amazed to find that it is the same as the code used by the British government to identify its own employees - a small but important role for Kevin Eldon.
rows.reference: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.

rows.source: Ó jẹ́ ohun tóba gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀ jẹ́ fún adarí ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọbà ẹnití ó jẹ́ àwòrán ológe àti ẹnití ogun ńjà kan, tó ńjìyà ìyọ́bí-òrí pátápátá ti òṣèlú tíkò gbajúmọ̀: Emma Thompson ṣe ohun tí ó dára jùlọ tí o leè ṣe pẹ́lù ìwà tí kòfi-gbogbo-arajọti-Teresa-May ṣùgbọ́n kòsí nǹkan púpọ̀ ninu àkọsílẹ̀ eré náà láti ṣiṣ̵ẹ́ pẹ̀lú.
rows.output: It is a given that the leader of the Conservative party, who is a former soldier and a staunch Brexiteer, is going to be a disaster: Emma Thompson does her best with the role of Theresa May, but there is not much in the script to work with.
rows.reference: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.

rows.source: Àwọn olùdámọ̀ràn iṣẹ́ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ rẹ̀ sọ fún un pé níwọn ìgbàtí ìkọ̀ọ̀kan ninu àwọn àmì ti gbọ̀jẹ̀gẹ́, yóò nílò láti mú ẹnìkan wá láti inu ìfẹ̀yìntì.
rows.output: His advisors told him that since all of the signs were in favor of the journey, he would need to bring someone from the retirement home.
rows.reference: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.

rows.source: Àtipé ìyẹn túmọ̀ si Johnny English aláìlọ́wọ́ fúnrarẹ̀, tíwọn ti fún níṣẹ́ bíi ọ̀gá ilé ìwé nílé iṣẹ́ tódùn un wò kan, ṣùgbọ́n fífún ni àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ aílàlákọsílẹ̀ nipa bí a ti ńjẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̀ kan: àwọn ẹ̀fẹ̀ apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín níbí, bí English sooe ńfúnni ni irúfẹ́-Ilé-ìwé-ti-Àpáta ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ti amí ṣíṣe.
rows.output: That means Johnny English himself, who was once a humble desk clerk, has been given a promotion to head a secret intelligence agency, but is instead given crash courses in how to be a top spy: here are the hilarious results, as English stumbles his way through the world of espionage.
rows.reference: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.

rows.source: English níwọn ti gbé padà ní kíákía sí Whitehall fún ìbanisọ̀rọ̀ pàjáwìrì tí ó sì túnwà níṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ tímọ́tímọ́ tóńjìyà fúngbà pípẹ́ Bough, tí wọn ṣe eré rẹ̵̀ lẹ́ẹ́kan síi láti ọwọ́ Ben Miller.
rows.output: He returned to Whitehall for a press conference and reunited with his long-time partner in crime, Bough, who performed the role again from Ben Miller.
rows.reference: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.

rows.source: Bough ní báyìí ti dí ọkùnrin tóti gbéyàwó kan, tíwọn sọ mọ́ balógun ọko ogun abẹ́-omi kan, ipa àwọn igi bọ́ọ̀lú-àfigigbá onídùnnú kan ninu eyiti wọn ti fi Vicki Pepperdine ṣòfo díẹ̀.
rows.output: Now, a man who had been married to a woman, who was a commander of a naval warship, was having an affair with a ballerina, in which Vicki Pepperdine was involved.
rows.reference: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.

rows.source: Nítorínáà Batman àti Robin ti mimu àwọn nǹkan mẹ̀hẹ gidigidi níbi Iṣ̵ẹ́ Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̵́ ti Ọbabìnrin Ọlọ́lá Jùlọ ti padà sẹnu iṣẹ́, tíwọn sì ńṣe aláàbápàdé obìnrin àrẹwà amúniṣagbère Ophelia Bulletova ti Olgs Kurylenko.
rows.output: So Batman and Robin have been doing a lot of heavy lifting at the crime lab of the Lady Justice Police Department, and they're having a lovely time with the beautiful, amiable Ophelia Bulletova of Olgs Kurylenko.
rows.reference: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.

rows.source: Ẹwẹ, adarí ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọba ǹsubú lọ́nà tóléwu lábẹ̵́ èèdì ti ọlọ̀pọ̀-èrò oníṣẹ́ ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ olówó rẹpẹtẹ tí ó sọpé òun leè yanjú awọn ìyọnu kọ̀m̀pútà ti orilẹ-ede Britain: aláàrékérekè Jason Volta, tí Jake Lacy ṣe.
rows.output: However, the leader of the subjugated government in a remote corner of the land of the wealthy engineer, Jason Volta, who is played by Jake Lacy, is a very strange man.
rows.reference: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.

rows.source: English ati Bough bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrìn-àjò gígùn ti àwàdà aláriwo kan: wọ́n múra bíi àwọn agbáwo, wọn fi iná sí ilé oúnjẹ tójọjú ilẹ̀ Faranse kan; wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá ìdàrúdàpọ̀ nìbití wọ́n ti ṣe fàyàwọ́ ara wọn wọnú ọkọ̀ oju-omi ọlọ́lá ti Volta; ti English sì ṣe okùnfà aáwọ̀ bí ó ti ńgbìyànjú láti lo agbékọ́rí láti fi ara rẹ̀ mọ inu ilé ti Volta náà.
rows.output: English and Bough embarked on a raucous adventure: they lurched about like drunks, setting fire to a French restaurant; they created a ruckus by pouring gasoline into the hull of the Volta; and English even tried to stuff himself into the Volta's cabin with a crowbar.
rows.reference: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.

rows.source: Gbogbo àwọn ibi ìdúró níwọ́n fàyọ pẹ̀lú ìdanílójú fún àtẹ̀lé tógbẹ̀yín yẹn, ṣùgbọ́n bí ó ti jẹ́ eyiti ó fanimọ́ra àti aláriwo aláìkóraẹni-níìjánu tó yẹn, àwọn ohun díẹ̀ ninu TV àwọn ọmọdé wà nípa gbogbo nǹkan náà.
rows.output: All the stops are in place with the assurance of the next train, but as it is the most comfortable and quiet one of all, there are only a few things on the TV for the children.
rows.reference: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.

rows.source: Nǹkan alábọ́de tórẹwà.
rows.output: A delicious dish.
rows.reference: Pretty moderate stuff.

rows.output: The FBI's involvement in the allegations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed the confirmation vote for his position on the Supreme Court for at least a week, and raises questions about whether the information the agency uncovered could be used to sway any of the key Republican senators to withdraw their support.

rows.output: In its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see thousands of people gather in Central Park's Great Lawn to enjoy performances by artists like Janet Jackson, Cardi B, and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the festival's goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.

rows.source: Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé náà, eyiti wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́dún 2012, jẹ́ àmúgbòòrò tí Iṣẹ́ Àkànṣe ti Ìṣẹ́ Àgbáyé, ẹgbẹ́ aláàtẹnumọ́ ti àgbáyé kan ńrétí láti fòpin sí ìṣẹ́ nípa mímú iye àwọn eniyan tó ńṣiṣẹ́ gidigidi nípa dídojú ìjà kọ ọ́ pọ̀síi.
rows.output: The Global Urban Youth Summit, which began in 2012, is a flagship program of the Global Alliance for the Future of Work, a global coalition of organizations working to address the challenges of precarious work by promoting the rights of young people.

rows.output: To qualify for a free ticket to the event (unless they want to pay for a ticket for a VERY IMPORTANT PERSON), those going to the outside ceremony must complete a task or "job" such as volunteering for a job, writing an email to a boss, or doing any other way to show their commitment to stop working.

rows.source: Ó ńsọpé àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe wọ̀nyí ti ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti ṣọ àwọn olóri àgbáyé ji láti kéde àwọn ìfiraẹnijìn àti àwọn ìlàna ètò tí ó ju bílíọ̀nù mẹ́tàdínlógójì dọ́là lọ eyiti wọ́n ti ṣètò rẹ̀ láti la ipa lórí ayé àwọn eniyan tóju bílíọ̀nù 2.25 lọ kí ó tó di ọdún 2030.
rows.output: He says these actions have helped to alert world leaders to the declarations and plans of action worth over $120 billion that have been set up to influence the lives of 2.25 billion people by 2030.
rows.reference: It says that these actions have helped spur world leaders to announce commitments and policies equating to more than $37 billion that is set to affect the lives of more than 2.25 billion people by 2030.

rows.source: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún 2018, ẹgbẹ́ náà tọ́kasí àwọn ìfarajin àti àwọn ìkéde tí ó jáde láti inu àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe rẹ̀, ó kéré tán bílíọ̀nù mẹ́wàá dọ́là ninu eyiti wọ́n ti pín tàbí tíwọn ti kójọ.
rows.output: In the beginning of 2018, the group indicated that it had received and issued invoices for at least ten billion dollars in work, of which it had either received or collected.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ṣe àfojúdá àwọn owó tówà lábẹ́ ààbò eyiti ó ti la ipa tààrà lórí àwọn eniyan tó súnmọ́ mílíọ̀nù ẹgbẹ̀ta-léní-mọ́kàndínláàádọ́ta káàkiri àgbáyé.
rows.output: The group has raised millions of dollars under the guise of charity, which has had a devastating impact on millions of people around the world.
rows.reference: The group estimates the secured funds have so far made a direct impact on nearly 649 million people across the world.

rows.source: Àwọn kan lára àwọn ìfaraẹnijìn pàtàkì ni Agbára Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ̀, aláàjọṣiṣẹ́pọ àwọn olùdóokoòwò àti àwọn amúṣẹ́ṣe ní orilẹ-ede UK tíwọ́n farajìn fún ''ṣiṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn ọmọdé láti de ibi ipá wọn lẹ́ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́,'' tó ńṣe ìlérí láti pèsè mílíọnù márùndínlógójì dọ́là gún orilẹ-ede Rwanda latí fòpin sí àìtó oúnjẹ aṣaralóore ní orilẹ-ede náà lẹ́yìn tógba àwọn àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tuwiti tólé ní ẹgbẹ́rùn lọ́ná máàrún dín ní ọ̀ọ́dún lọ́wọ́ Àwọn Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé.
rows.output: Some of the key supporters include Food Aid, a coalition of traders and aid workers in the UK who are committed to "helping children to reach their full potential," which has pledged to provide $44 million to Rwanda to end child malnutrition in the country after taking over the management of Twitter accounts of five NGOs in five years.
rows.reference: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a U.K. based partnership of investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential," promising to provide Rwanda with $35 million to help end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from Global Citizens.

rows.source: ''Pẹ̀lú àtìlẹ́yìn láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba orilẹ-ede UK, àwọn afúnnilówó. àwọn ìjọba orilẹ-ede, àti Àwọn Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé bíi ìwọ, a leè sọ àìsí ìdájọ́ òdodo ìbaṣepọ̀ ti àìtó oúnjẹ aṣaralóore dí àkọsílẹ abẹ́-ẹṣé kan ninu ìtàn,'' àṣojú Agbára ti Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ Náà Tracey Ullman sọ fún àwọm èrò nigba ìpéjọpọ̀ àwọn eléré bóti ńwáyé ní ìlú Lọndọnu ní oṣu Igbe lọ́dún 2018.
rows.output: "With the support of the UK government, investors, governments, and NGOs like yours, we can say that the lack of a just and sustainable food system is a crime against history," said Tracey Ullman, a representative of the Food Foundation, during a panel discussion in London in November 2018.
rows.reference: "With support from the UK government, donors, national governments, and Global Citizens just like you, we can make the social injustice of undernutrition a footnote in history," The Power of Nutrition ambassador Tracey Ullman told the crowd during a live concert in London in April 2018.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ náà tún sọpé lẹ́yìn tí wọn ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe to ju ẹgbẹ̀rúnn máàrún lọ eyiti ó ńpè orilẹ-ede U.K. láti jẹ́kí ìmúdárasíi bá oúnjẹ jíjẹ fún àwọn ìyá àti àwọn ọmọdé, ìjọba náà kédé owó ìfifúnni fún iṣẹ́ àkànṣe kan, Agbára ti Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ, eyiti yóò leè fọwọ́kan àwọn ìyá àti àwọn ọmọdé mílíọ̀nù máàrún pẹ̀lú àwọn ìdásí oúnjẹ jíjẹ.
rows.output: The group also said that after performing more than five million tasks which call on the UK government to make food poverty a priority for pregnant women and children, the government has allocated funding for a pilot scheme, the Food Power scheme, which will be able to reach five million pregnant women and children with food poverty-related benefits.
rows.reference: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions were taken calling on the U.K. improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project, the Power of Nutrition, that will reach 5 million women and children with nutrition interventions.

rows.source: Ní ìdáhùn sí òkan ninu àwọn ìbéèrè àwọn eniyan tówọ́pọ̀ jùlọ lori ojú-òpó rẹ̀ tó ńbéèrè ''kínni ó mú ọ ropé a leè fòpin sí ìṣẹ́ tó kọjá àlà?''

rows.output: The citizen of the world replied: "It will be a long way - sometimes we will sink and sometimes we will fail.

rows.output: But, as with the previous wave of anti-personnel and anti-landmine groups, we will succeed, because we have a lot more power together.

rows.output: The US can use Special Forces to "seize" oil fields in Venezuela to sell - State Department official

rows.output: Washington can "act if necessary" to prevent the arrival of goods from Russia, and in the Middle East, US Secretary of State Rex Tillerson has shown, as the Washington Examiner has noted.
rows.reference: Washington can "if necessary" resort to its Navy to prevent Russian energy hitting the markets, including in the Middle East, US Internal Secretary Ryan Zinke has revealed, as cited by Washington Examiner.

rows.source: Zinke fẹ̀sùn kàn wipe ìbáṣepọ̀ ilẹ̀ Rọ́síà pẹ̀lú ilẹ̀ Síríà - níti àkíyèsi, níbití ó ti ńṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lù ìfìwépe ìjọba tóbá òfin mu náà - jẹ́ ọgbọń láti ṣáwàrí àwọn ọjà fún nǹkan agbára tuntun.
rows.output: Zinke complained that the relationship between the Syrian government and the country of Israel - in particular, the fact that it was working with a government that was not recognized as legitimate - was a cover for exploring markets for a new weapon.
rows.reference: Zinke alleged that Russia's engagement in Syria - notably, where it is operating at the invitation of the legitimate government - is a pretext to explore new energy markets.

rows.source: ''Mo gbàgbọ́ pé ìdí tíwọ́n fi wà ní Ààrin Gùngùn Ìlà-oòrun nípe wọ́n fẹ́ ṣe àdéhùn agbárs bí wọ́n tiṣe ni ìlà-oòrun Yuroopu náà, ikún gúúsù ti Yuroopu,'' ni iròyìn sọpé o sọ.
rows.output: "I believe that the reason they are in the Central Highlands is that they want to make a deal as they have in Western Europe, the southern part of Europe," the report said.
rows.reference: "I believe the reason they are in the Middle East is they want to broker energy just like they do in eastern Europe, the southern belly of Europe," he has reportedly said.

rows.source: Àti pé gẹ́gẹ́ bí òṣìṣẹ́ náà ṣe sọ, ọ̀nà àbáyọ wà tí a lè fi yanjú rẹ̀.
rows.output: And as the employee said, there is a way to solve the problem.

rows.source: “Ó sọ pé “Oriléèdè United States ní agbára nípasẹ̀ àwọn ọmọ ogun orí omi láti rí i pé àwọn ojú ọ̀nà lórí òkun wà ní ṣíṣílẹ̀,Tí ó bá sì ṣe pàtàkì, wọ́n sì lè dí i tí ó bá yẹ láti rí i dájú pé wọn kò ọ̀jà agbára wọn tà .
rows.output: "He said the United States has the power through its naval forces to ensure that sea lanes remain open, and if necessary, to prevent the free flow of oil."
rows.reference: "The United States has that ability, with our Navy, to make sure the sea lanes are open, and, if necessary, to blockade, to make sure that their energy does not go to market," he said.

rows.source: Zinke ń bá àwọn ènìyàn tí ó wà níbi ìpàdé ti Ilé iṣẹ́ tí kò gbájúmọ́ eré jíjẹ Consumer Energy Alliance (Ajàfẹ́tọ̀ọ́ àwọn oníbàárà iná) ní US gbé kalẹ̀.
rows.output: Zinke is meeting with people at the meeting of the non-lobbying Consumer Energy Alliance (Consumer Energy Alliance) in the US.
rows.reference: Zinke was addressing the attendees of the event hosted by the Consumer Energy Alliance, a non-profit group which styles itself as the "voice of the energy consumer" in the US.

rows.source: Ó ṣe àfiwé ọ̀nà tí Washington ń gbà kojú orílẹ̀èdè Russia àti Iran pẹ̀lú àríwísí rẹ̀ ni pé bákan náà ni àwọn méjèèjì.
rows.output: He compared the way Washington was dealing with the country of Russia and Iran with his criticism that both countries were similar in that they were both.
rows.reference: He went to compare Washington's approaches to dealing with Russia and Iran, noting that they are effectively the same.

rows.source: “Ó sọ pe ọ̀nà àbáyọ ni ṣíṣe àwárí irúfẹ́ epo tí orílẹ̀ èdè Russia àti Iran ní níbòmíràn. Ó tún tẹ̀síwájú pé orílẹ̀èdè Russia ò ní ohun mìíràn tí wọ́n gbójúlé fún ọrọ̀ bí kò ṣe epo.
rows.output: He said that the solution is to find a type of oil that Russia and Iran have in other places. He also continued that Russia has no other interests except for oil.
rows.reference: "The economic option on Iran and Russia is, more or less, leveraging and replacing fuels," he said, while referring to Russia as a "one trick pony" with an economy dependent on fossil fuels.

rows.source: Àwọn gbólóhùn yìí wáyé pẹ̀lú bí ìṣàkóṣo ìjọba Trump ń gbìyànjú láti fikún iye gáàsì tí ó ń tà ní Europe pẹ̀lú ìgbìyànjú láti fi ìdínwó gáàsì ti wọn lé Russia kúrò lọ́jà.
rows.output: These statements came as the Trump administration was trying to increase the amount of gas it was selling in Europe while also trying to remove the gas restrictions that had been imposed on Russia.
rows.reference: The statements come as Trump administration has been on a mission to boost the export of its liquefied natural gas to Europe, replacing Russia, the far cheaper option for European consumers.

rows.source: Nítorí ìdí èyí ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ Ìjọba Trump àti Trump fúnra rẹ̀ ṣe ń gbìyànjú láti yí orílẹ̀èdè Germany lọ́kàn padà kí wọ́n lè jáwọ́ nínú iṣẹ́ àkànṣè Nord Stream 2 pipeline project tí Trump wòye pé òun ló mú Russia jẹ gàba lórí ìjọba Germany.
rows.output: That's why Trump administration officials and Trump himself have been trying to sway the German government to abandon the Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which Trump believes he has made Russia a vassal of the German government.
rows.reference: For that effect, the Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, try to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which according to Trump, made Berlin Moscow's "captive."

rows.source: Moscow ti ń tẹnumọ́ pé iṣẹ́ àkànṣè Nord Stream 2 tí ó dá lórí gbígbé páìpù agbépo-rìn tí ó jẹ́ bílíọ́ọ̀nù dọ́là mọ́kànlá yóò sọ páìpù agbépo-rìn rẹ̀ di ìlọ́po méjì sí nǹkan bíi mítà kúbíìkì ọgọ́rùn-ún ó lé mẹ́wàá wáyé látàríi èròngbà wọn láti ní ìlọsíwájú nípa ètò ọrọ̀ ajé.
rows.output: Moscow has emphasized that the completion of the Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which costs $11 billion, will double the capacity of the pipeline to 55 billion cubic meters and is part of their efforts to improve the economic situation.
rows.reference: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity to 110 billion cubic meters, is a purely economic project.

rows.source: Ìjọba Russia wòye pé ìjọba orílẹ̀èdè Amẹ́ríkà ń tako iṣẹ́ àkànṣè náà nítorí ìtara àti wọn kò fẹ́ kí Russia ní ìlọsíwájú nípa ètò ọrọ̀ ajé bíi tiwọn.
rows.output: The Russian government believes that the US government is sabotaging the project because of its popularity and does not want Russia to achieve economic success like theirs.
rows.reference: The Kremlin argues that Washington's fervent opposition to the project is simply driven by economic reasons and is an example of unfair competition.

rows.source: "Mínísítà fún ọ̀rọ̀ epo ní orílẹ̀èdè Russia Aleksandr Novak, lẹ́yìn ìpàdé rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Sẹ́kẹ́tìrì fún ọ̀rọ̀ epo ni US tó wáyé ní oṣù kẹsàán ní Moscow sọ pé àwọn Mínísítà méjèèjì gbàgbọ́ pé epo kìí ṣe ohun tí ó tọ́ láti máa fi jẹ gàba lórí àwọn ènìyàn àti o yẹ kí àwọn oníbàárà le yan ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bá wù wọ́n láti ra epo lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.output: Minister of Energy of the Russian Federation Aleksandr Novak, following his meeting with the US Secretary of Energy in September in Moscow, stated that both ministers believe that oil should not be used as a tool to pressure people and that consumers should be able to choose anyone they want to buy oil from.
rows.reference: "I believe we share the view that energy cannot be a tool to exercise pressure and that consumers should be able to choose the suppliers," Russian Energy Minister Aleksandr Novak said following a meeting with US Energy Secretary Rick Perry in Moscow in September.

rows.source: Ìgbésẹ̀ US lórí ọ̀rọ̀ yìí ti mú kí orílẹ̀èdè Germany bu ẹnu àtẹ́ lu wọ́n ,Germany sì pinnu pé àwọn kò ní jáwọ́ nínú iṣẹ́ àkànṣè náà.
rows.output: The US action on this matter has led to Germany publicly criticizing them, and Germany has decided not to withdraw from the project.
rows.reference: The US stance has drawn backlash from Germany, which has reaffirmed its commitment to the project.

rows.source: Ilé iṣẹ́ tí ó ga jù lọ ní orílẹ̀èdè Germany, Federation of German Industries (BDI) ti képe orílẹ̀èdè US láti gbójú kúrò lára adehun tí Russia àti Germany ṣe lórí ọ̀rọ̀ à ń ta epo.
rows.output: The highest industrial organization in Germany, the Federation of German Industries (BDI), has urged the US to withdraw from the agreement between Russia and Germany on the issue of gas exports.
rows.reference: Germany's leading organization for industry, the Federation of German Industries (BDI), has called on the US to stay away from the EU energy policy and the bilateral agreements between Berlin and Moscow.

rows.source: "Ọ̀gá ilé iṣẹ́ Federation of German Industries (BDI), lẹ́yìn ìpàdé pẹ̀lú adarí orílẹ̀èdè Germany Angela Merkel àti ààrẹ orílẹ̀èdè Russia Vladimir Putin ní àìpẹ́ yìí ṣàlàyé pé òun kò nífẹ̀ẹ́ kí orílẹ̀èdè kan máa dásí àdéhùn tí àwọn orílẹ̀èdè mìíràn ṣe pẹ̀lú ara wọn.
rows.output: The head of the Federation of German Industries (BDI), after a meeting with German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Russian President Vladimir Putin, explained that he does not want a country to impose an agreement that other countries have made with each other.
rows.reference: "I have a big problem when a third state interferes in our energy supply," Dieter Kempf, head of the Federation of German Industries (BDI) said following a recent meeting between German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

rows.source: Aṣòfin fún ìlú Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren yóò ronú jinlẹ̀ nípa bóyá yóò díje fún ipò ààrẹ ní ọdún 2020
rows.output: Senator for Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren will consider deeply whether she will run for the presidency in 2020
rows.reference: Elizabeth Warren Will Take "Hard Look" At Running For President in 2020, Massachusetts Senator Says

rows.source: Aṣòfin fún ìlú Massachusetts, lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta sọ pé òun yóò ronú jinlẹ̀ nípa bóyá yóò díje fún ipò ààrẹ ní ọdún 2020 lẹ́yìn ètò ìdìbò àárín sáà.
rows.output: The Massachusetts State Senator, on Tuesday, said that he would consider running for the presidency in 2020 after the mid-term elections.
rows.reference: Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Saturday she would take a "hard look" at running for president following the midterm elections.

rows.source: Nínú ìpàdé tí ó wáyé ní gbọ̀gán ìlú Massachusetts, Warren fi dá àwọn tí ó wà nibẹ̀ lójú pé òun yóò ronú púpọ̀ nípa ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
rows.output: In a meeting held in the city of Massachusetts, Warren assured those present that he would give a lot of thought to the matter.
rows.reference: During a town hall in Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren confirmed she'd consider running.

rows.source: "Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìwé ìròyìn The Hill ṣe àfihàn hàn, arábìnrin náà sọ pé ó ti tó àkókò fún àwọn obìnrin láti gbà ìṣàkóso ìjọba, kí wọ́n sì ṣe àtúnṣe ìjọba pẹ̀lú obìnrin gẹ́gẹ́ bí adarí.
rows.output: As reported by The Hill, the sister stated that it is time for women to take control of the government and make adjustments to the government with a woman as leader.
rows.reference: "It's time for women to go to Washington and fix our broken government and that includes a woman at the top," she said, according to The Hill.

rows.source: Lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ kẹfà oṣù kọọkànlá, n ó ronú nípa gbígbé igbá ìdìbò fún ipò ààrẹ.
rows.output: After the sixth of November, I will be thinking about running for the position of president.
rows.reference: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."

rows.source: Warren bu ẹnu àtẹ́ẹnu lu ààrẹ Donald Trump ní ìpàdé náà, ó ṣàlàyé ọ̀nà àìtọ́ ni ọ̀nà tí Trump ń ti orílẹ̀èdè US sí.
rows.output: Warren criticized President Donald Trump at the meeting, explaining the wrong way that Trump is leading the country.
rows.reference: Warren weighed in on President Donald Trump during the town hall, saying he was "taking this county in the wrong direction.

rows.source: “Ó ń kan mí lóminú ohun tí Trump ń ṣe sí ìjọba tiwantiwa” ni ohun tí Warren sọ.
rows.output: "It's just so insulting what Trump is doing to democracy," said Warren.
rows.reference: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.

rows.source: Warren ti ń ké gbàjarè látẹ̀yìnwá pé Trump àti ẹni tí ó yàn sípò ilé ẹjọ́ tí ó ga jù lọ Brett Kavanaugh ń ṣe ìjọba báṣubàṣu.
rows.output: Warren has been warning for some time that Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh are making a mockery of the judiciary.
rows.reference: Warren has been outspoken in her criticism of Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Warren sọ̀rọ̀ ní ọjọ́ ẹtì lórí ẹ̀rọ tíwítà pé ó ṣe pàtàkì kí àjọ FBI ṣe ìwádìí ìjọba kí ètò ìdìbò mìíràn tó dé."
rows.output: Warren spoke on Twitter on Election Day that it was important for the FBI to investigate the government before another election occurred.
rows.reference: In a tweet on Friday, Warren said "of course we need an FBI investigation before voting."

rows.source: Lódì kejì, ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn olùgbé agbègbè tí Warren ti wá ni kò fara mọ́ ọ pé kí Warren díje ní ọdún 2020 gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìbò afèròhàn lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ṣe fi hàn ní Ọjọ́bọ̀.
rows.output: Secondly, many of the residents of the area that Warren had come to know were not aware that Warren was running in 2020 as social media polls had shown.
