rows.source: Awọn ẹgbẹ sọ daju pe yoo tẹsiwaju pẹlu igbiyanju lati ni asọye pẹlu Brussels pelu isọrọdisi - ati ki o fi ipa mu Eurosceptics ati Ẹgbẹ oṣiṣẹ lati yan laarin ohun ti o sọ ati 'Idarudapọ'.
rows.output: The group insisted that it would continue with the efforts to negotiate with Brussels, despite the disintegration - and force Eurosceptics and the workers' party to choose between what they said and 'Chaos'.
rows.reference: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Bone sọ fun iwọde Fisilẹ Tumọsi Fisilẹ ni Solihull pe oun fẹ lati 'Fun Awọn Alayẹwo'.
rows.output: Mr. Bone told the Solihull News that he wanted to be 'For the Inspectors'.
rows.reference: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.

rows.source: O daba pe Ọgbẹni Farage yẹ lati jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ kan ki o si ni ojuse lati ṣe idunadura pẹlu Brussels.
rows.output: Mr. Farage should be a member and have a responsibility to negotiate with Brussels.
rows.reference: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.

rows.source: 'Ti o ba jẹ olori, a o ti jade ni bayi,' o wi pe
rows.output: "If you're the leader, we'll leave now," he said.
rows.reference: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.

rows.source: MP ti Welingborough fi kun: 'Emi yoo duro fun Brexit ṣugbọn a nilo lati ṣawari Awọn Oluṣayẹwo.'
rows.output: Member for Wellingborough: 'I will support Brexit but we need to explore the Inspectors.'
rows.reference: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'

rows.source: Ṣiṣeto atako yii si EU, o sọ bẹẹ: 'A ko ja ogun agbaye lati wa laaye.
rows.output: Setting up this attack on the EU, he said: 'We are not fighting a global war to survive.
rows.reference: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.

rows.source: A fẹ ṣe awọn ofin ti ara wa ni orilẹ-ede wa.'
rows.output: We want to make our own laws in our country.
rows.reference: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Bone fagile imọran pe ero ti awọn eniyan ti yipada lati ọdun idibo 2016: 'Awọn idaniloju pe awọn eniyan Britani ti yi ọkàn wọn pada ati pe wọn fẹ lati duro jẹ irọ patapata.'
rows.output: Mr Bone dismissed the idea that the public's mind had changed since the 2016 referendum: 'The assumption that the British public have changed their minds and want to stay in the EU is a complete myth.'
rows.reference: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns naa wa ni iwọde, o sọ fun awọn oniroyin: 'Mo kan n sọ pe: Minisita Alakoso, fetisi awọn eniyan.
rows.output: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was overheard, telling reporters: 'I just say: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.

rows.source: 'Awọn Oluṣayẹwo jẹ alailokiki lọdọ gbogbogbo, Alatako ko ni dibo fun, ko lokiki ninu ẹgbẹ wa ati awọn ajijagbara wa ti o wa ita gbangba lati dibo fun wa.
rows.output: The Inspectors are unknown to the public, the Alakoso is not elected, is not popular in our party and our rebels outside are not voting for us.
rows.reference: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.

rows.source: Jọwọ fi awọn Ṣayẹwo silẹ ki o bẹrẹ si gbọ.'
rows.output: Please check and start listening.
rows.reference: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'

rows.source: Ninu ifiranṣẹ ti o tọ si Arabinrin May, o fi kun: 'Awọn aṣoju Minisita n pa iṣẹ wọn mọ nigba ti wọn ko ba mu awọn ileri wọn ṣẹ.'
rows.output: In a message to Mrs. May, he added: 'Ministerial representatives are sabotaging their work when they do not fulfill their commitments.'
rows.reference: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Farage sọ fun awọn oluwọlu pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ ‘lero ooru’ lara ti wọn ba fẹ yi ipinnu ti a ṣe ni idibo ti 2016 pada.
rows.output: Mr. Farage told the audience that politicians must "listen to the heat" of the people if they want to change the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.reference: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.

rows.source: 'Eyi jẹ nipa ọrọ ifọkantan laarin wa - awọn eniyan - ati egbe oselu wa,' o sọ.
rows.output: This is about the relationship between us - the people - and our political party, he said.
rows.reference: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.

rows.source: 'Wọn n gbiyanju lati da Brexit a wa loni lati sọ fun wọn pe,' Awa ki yoo jẹ ki ẹ mu eleyi jẹ'.
rows.output: They are trying to stop Brexit today to tell us, 'We will make this happen.'
rows.reference: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'

rows.source: Ninu ifiranṣẹ kan si ero ti o ni itara ti o fi kun: 'Mo fẹ ki ẹ jẹki awọn oselu wa, ti o wa ni ipo dida Brexit, lero ooru naa.
rows.output: In a message to the passionate pro-Brexit camp: 'I want you to be proud of our politics, which are in a state of flux due to Brexit, and to feel the heat.
rows.reference: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.

rows.source: 'A n ṣe akojọ ẹgbẹ ọmọ ogun ti orilẹ-ede yii ti o fun wa ni iṣẹgun ni Brexit ati pe ko ni si isimi titi di igba ti a ba ti di ominira, iṣakoso ara-ẹni, ounyangan iṣejọba ara ẹni United Kingdom.'
rows.output: 'We are making a list of the members of this national army that gave us the victory in Brexit and that will not have any representation until we have become a free, self-governing, independent United Kingdom.'
rows.reference: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'

rows.source: Nibayi, Ramainers wọ kọja Birmingham ṣaaju ki wọn to pejọ fun iwọde wakati meji ni aarin ilu naa.
rows.output: Meanwhile, Ramainers moved across Birmingham before gathering for a two-hour rally in the city center.
rows.reference: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.

rows.source: Awọn alakikanju ti awọn ajafitafita lo Tories Lodi si Asia Brexit lẹhin ifilole ẹgbẹ naa ni ìparí ọsẹ yii.
rows.output: The rebels of the pro-European faction have launched a Tory Brexit against Asia after the launch of the party at the end of the week.
rows.reference: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.

rows.source: Ẹlẹgbẹ Oṣiṣẹ Oluwa Adonis ṣe ẹlẹya awọn olutẹle ohun atẹhinwa nitori iṣẹlẹ aabo ti wọn ni pẹlu iṣafilọlẹ ẹgbẹ kan bi apejọ ti ṣí bẹrẹ.
rows.output: Adonis' colleague, the laborer, mocked the followers of the atehinwa due to the security incident they had with the group's launch as the meeting began.
rows.reference: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.

rows.source: 'Awọn wọnyi ni awọn eniyan ti o sọ fun wa pe wọn le ni awọn ilana IT ni ojuṣe ati gbogbo imọ-ẹrọ fun Canada ni afikun pẹlu, fun iyipo ailopin, fun iṣowo ọfẹ laisi awọn aala ni Ireland,’o fi kun.
rows.output: These are the people who tell us that they have the IT systems in place and all the technology for Canada, for an infinite loop, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.reference: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.

rows.source: 'O jẹ aiṣeeṣe patapata.
rows.output: It is simply impossible.
rows.reference: 'It is a complete farce.

rows.source: Kosi nnkan ti o dabi Brexit ti o dara,’o fi kun.
rows.output: It's not like a good Brexit, he added.
rows.reference: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.

rows.source: Warren ń gbèrò ‘gidi gan-an’ láti jẹ ààrẹ
rows.output: Warren is considering being 'really serious' about being president
rows.reference: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president

rows.source: ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà Sínátọ̀ Elizabeth Wareen ní òun “gbèrò gidi gan-an láti díje fún ipò ààrẹ” lẹ́yìn ibò oṣù kọkànlá.
rows.output: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren said she is "very serious about running for president" after the November election.
rows.reference: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.

rows.source: The Boston Globe ni àtẹ̀jáde yìí ti jáde ní àkókò tí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat ti ìlú Massachusetts ṣe ìpàdé pẹ̀lú àwọn ará ẹkùn ẹ̀ ní iwọ̀-oòrùn Massachusetts ní ọjọ́ Sátidé.
rows.output: This edition of The Boston Globe was published at a time when a Democratic Party official of the city of Boston met with residents of the western suburbs of Massachusetts on Saturday.
rows.reference: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.

rows.source: Warren, alátakò Ààrẹ Donald Trump ní gbogbo ìgbà, máa díjẹ lẹ́ẹ̀kan si pẹ̀lú Geoff Diehl , ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican àti aṣojú ìpínlẹ̀ ní oṣù kọkànlá. Diehl jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn alága ní ìlú Massachusetts fún ìpolongo Trump ní 2016.
rows.output: Warren, a long-time critic of President Donald Trump, is once again running against Geoff Diehl, a Republican and state representative, in November. Diehl was one of the leaders in Massachusetts for Trump's 2016 campaign.
rows.reference: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.

rows.source: Àwọn èèyàn tí n sọ káàkiri pé ó fẹ́ díje ju ipò ààrẹ pẹlú Trump ni ọdún 2020.
rows.output: People who were saying that he wanted to run against Trump in 2020.
rows.reference: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.

rows.source: Ìpàdé tó wáyé ní ọ̀sán Sátidé ní Holyoke ni ìpàdé ìkẹ́rindínlógójì (36) tó ṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn t’ọ́n wà ní ẹkùn ẹ̀ láti ìgbà tí Trump ti wọlé.
rows.output: The meeting that took place in the afternoon of Saturday in Holyoke is the 36th meeting that has taken place with the members present from the left since Trump took office.
rows.reference: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.

rows.source: Ọ̀kan nínú àwọn t’ọ́n wà fún ìpàdé náà bíi léèrè pé ǹjẹ́ ó ń pinnu láti jẹ ààrẹ?
rows.output: One of the reasons for the meeting was to ask if he was really determined to be president.
rows.reference: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.

rows.source: Warren ní àkókò ti tó “fún àwọn òbinrin láti lọ sí Washington láti to ìjọba tó doríkodò, àti pé obìnrin gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ olórí.”
rows.output: Warren had time for "women to go to Washington to run the government, and a woman had to be in charge."
rows.reference: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."

rows.source: Ìtìmọ́lé ẹni tó yìnbọn pa Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU
rows.output: The shooting death of Sims, a former LSU football player
rows.reference: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims

rows.source: Ní ọjọ́ Sátidé, àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue, La., kéde àtìmọ́lé olùfurasí tó yìnbọn pa Wayde Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU, ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.
rows.output: On Saturday, the Baton Rouge, La., police announced the arrest of a shooter who killed Wayde Sims, a member of the LSU football team, on Friday.
rows.reference: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.

rows.source: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue kéde àtìmọ́lé Dyteon Simpson, ọmọ ogún ọdún (20) ní aago mọkànlá òwúrọ̀ lásìkò.
rows.output: The Baton Rogue Police announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, a 20-year-old man, at 11am this morning.
rows.reference: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.

rows.source: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣe àfihàn fídíò ìbọn yínyìn ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Wọ́n ní ẹni tó bá dá ẹni tó yìnbọn náà mọ̀, kó sọ fún àwọn.
rows.output: The police released a video of the shooting on Thursday. They said anyone who can identify the shooter should come forward.
rows.reference: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.

rows.source: Ní kùtùkùtù ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, nítọ̀sí Southern University, ni ọta ìbọn ba Sims, ọmọ ogun (20) ọdún, tó sì kú.
rows.output: On Wednesday morning, near Southern University, a bullet struck Sims, a 20-year-old soldier, who died.
rows.reference: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.

rows.source: Ọ̀gá ọlọ́pàá, Murphy J. Paul sọ fún ilé-ìròyìn 247sports pe “Ọgbẹ́ orí látàrí ọta ìbọn tó ba Wayde Sims ló pa á.”
rows.output: Chief of Police Murphy J. Paul told 247sports that "The death of Wayde Sims was a result of a gunshot wound."
rows.reference: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde ń gbèjà ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀ ni kí Simpson tó yìnbọn fun un.
rows.output: Wayde is protecting his friend before Simpson shoots him.
rows.reference: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.

rows.source: Nínú ìdáhùn ẹ, Simpson jẹ́wọ́ pé òun wà ní ibi iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, òun ní ìbọn lọ́wọ́, àti pé òun ló yìnbọn fún Wayde Sims.
rows.output: In his defense, Simpson admitted that he was at the scene, that he had a gun, and that he was the one who shot Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.

rows.source: Simpson ‘ò bá àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣagídí bí wọ́n ṣe tì í mọ́ àtìmọ́lẹ́ ti àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní East Baton Rouge Parish.
rows.output: Simpson was acquitted by a jury of the charges against him, including the attempted murder of two police officers in East Baton Rouge Parish.
rows.reference: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.

rows.source: Sims, ọmọ tó ga fíofío, ṣe kékeré ẹ̀ ní Baton Rogue. Ní sáà tó kọjá, ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lu-aláfọwọ́gbá fún ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní ìgbà méjìlélọ́gbọ̀n (32). Ó bá wọn bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ẹ̀mẹwàá nínú ẹ̀.
rows.output: Sims, a tall, slender man, was a backup quarterback for the team in Baton Rogue. In the past, he threw for 32 touchdowns. He started in the tenth grade.
rows.reference: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.

rows.source: Erésísáonímọ́tò ní Russia Lewis Hamilton ló gbégbá orókè nínú ìdíjẹ àgbáyé. Mọ́tò tuntun tí Mercedes ráà ló fún ní àǹfààní láti borí Sebastian Vettel.
rows.output: The Russian Grand Prix was won by Lewis Hamilton. The new Mercedes car gave him the advantage over Sebastian Vettel.
rows.reference: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel

rows.source: Valtteri Bottas ló kọ́ dé ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsè tó kẹ́yìn ni ọjọ́ Sátidé. Bí Mercedes ṣe gbọ́, wọ́n ra mọ́tò míì tó kó ipa pàtàkì nínú eré náà.
rows.output: Valtteri Bottas won the last race on Saturday. As Mercedes said, they bought another car that played a crucial role in the race.
rows.reference: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.

rows.source: Botta bẹ̀rẹ̀ dáadáa. Ó ku díẹ̀ kó ti Hamilton kúrọ̀ lọ́nà torí ó fẹ́ gbé ipò kìíní. Kódà, ó lo Vettel láti ko lù ú.
rows.output: Botta started well. He died a little before Hamilton because he wanted to be first. Even so, he used Vettel to avoid hitting him.
rows.reference: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.

rows.source: Vettel ‘ò fi ọgbọ́n ṣe é. Ó já sí kòtò, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Hamilton wà lẹyìn nínú súnkere-fàkere.
rows.output: Vettel was too clever. He was the first to cross the line, and Hamilton was second.
rows.reference: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.

rows.source: Mercedes dúró níbi kòtò láti jáde lẹ́yìn Vettel. Láìpẹ́, Hamilton bọ́ síwájú. Àwọn awakọ̀ náà dá onírúurú ọgbọ́n bí wọ́n ṣe n wọkọ̀ . Awakọ̀ Ferari fi ojú-ọ̀nà sílẹ̀ torí kò fẹ́ ki ọkọ kọ̀ọ̀kan kọjá lára òun nígbà kẹta.
rows.output: Mercedes stopped at the pit lane to exit after Vettel. Recently, Hamilton advanced. The drivers used various strategies as they drove. Ferrari driver dropped the track because he did not want each car to pass him in the third place.
rows.reference: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.

rows.source: Max Verstappen ló gbẹ̀yìn. Ipò kèje ló wà nígbà tí wọ́n parí ipele kìíní. Ọjọ́ yẹn ló pé ọmọ 21 ọdún.
rows.output: Max Verstappen was the first to cross the finish line. He was in seventh position after the first stage. That was his 21st birthday.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.

rows.source: Ó gbìyànjú, ó sáré gan-an kó lè tètè parí, kó la Kimi Raikkonen kó lè gbé ipò kẹrin.
rows.output: He tried, he ran as fast as he could to finish, to overtake Kimi Raikkonen and secure fourth place.
rows.reference: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.

rows.source: Ní àkàsọ̀ 44, ó jásí kòtò. Bí kò ṣe lè sáré dáadáa mọ́ fún àkàsọ 8 tó kù. Bí Raikkonen se gbé ipò kẹrin nìyẹn.
rows.output: In the 44th lap, he was overtaken by a car. He couldn't catch up for the remaining 8 laps. That's how Raikkonen took fourth place.
rows.reference: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.

rows.source: Ọjọ́ ńlá ní lòní. Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Valtteri ṣe iṣẹ́ gidi ní ìparí ọ̀sẹ̀ àti èèyàn jẹ́jẹ́.
rows.output: Today is a big day. Despite Valtteri's hard work over the weekend, he's still behind.
rows.reference: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.

rows.source: Àmọ́ ikọ̀ tó kù ṣe dáadáa jù ú lọ t’ọ́n fi wà ní ipò 1 àti 2,” ni Hamilton sọ.
rows.output: But the remaining drivers were very good, and I was in position 1 and 2," said Hamilton.
rows.reference: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.

rows.source: Ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tí kò dára
rows.output: Poor communication

rows.source: Ààrẹ Donald Trump fi Sínátọ̀ Dianne Feinste ṣe yẹ̀yẹ́ torí ó ní òun ‘ọ́ tú lẹ́tà tí Christine Blasey Ford kọ síta, tó fi ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilòpọ̀ kan Brett Kavanaugh, ẹni tí ààre yan gẹ́gẹ́ bí adájọ́ sí Ilé-ìdájọ́ Àgbà ti ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.output: President Donald Trump praised Senator Dianne Feinstein for releasing the letter from Christine Blasey Ford, accusing Brett Kavanaugh, whom Trump had nominated as a judge to the Supreme Court of the United States.
rows.reference: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.

rows.source: Ní ìlú West Virginia, níbi ìpàdé pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́, Ààrẹ tí kò sọrọ̀ nípa òun tí Sínátọ̀ yí sọ fún ìgbìmọ̀ ẹjọ́ dídá ti Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà ní ohun tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà ṣàfihàn “ìkà àti àìlóòótó” àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: Donald Trump, Ààrẹ Amẹ́ríkà, fìdí ọ̀rọ̀ yí múlẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí. Ó gbówó lé owó-orí àwọn ọjà bíi sólà, irin àti alumí t’ọ́n ti China wàá.
rows.output: Donald Trump, the President of the United States, imposed tariffs on a number of products, including solar panels, iron, and aluminum, from China at the beginning of the year.

rows.source: Lọ́sẹ̀ yí àfikún tó dé bá owó-orí kan iye ọjà tó tó bílíọ́nù 200 dọ́là. China ni àwọn ọjà yí tí ń wá sí Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.output: This week's surge in imports added to a record trade deficit of $200 billion. China is the largest source of these imports to the US.
rows.reference: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.

rows.source: Beijing náà ṣe tiẹ̀. Ó gbé owó tó lé ní ìdá márùn-ún sí mẹ́wàá lorí àwọn ọjà to tó bílíọ́nù 60 dọ́là lórí àwọn ọjà tó ti Amẹ́ríkà wá.
rows.output: The Beijing government did this. It invested more than 15% of the value of $60 billion worth of imports from the United States on imports.
rows.reference: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.

rows.source: China ni ohun tí Amẹ́ríkà bá ṣe ni òun náà máa ṣe e. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò sí ohun tó lè mi ọ̀rọ̀-ajé China tó wà ní ipò kejì lágbàáyé.
rows.output: China will do to the United States what the United States will do to China. There is nothing that can stop China's economic rise to second place in the world.

rows.output: In America, people are free to do what they want. But for Xi Jinping, the President of China, he will not give up on America because it is too important.

rows.source: Àwọn onímọ̀ tẹnumọ pé bíi Beijing bá ta ayò ẹ̀ dáadáa, òun ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà yí nígbẹ̀yìn. Ìgbáralé ọjà tó ń ti ìú kọ̀ọ̀kan jáde ma dínkù
rows.output: Experts say that if Beijing sells the carbon credits, it will be a major advantage in the future. The market for emissions reduction will be reduced.

rows.source: ”Yálà láti Washington tàbí Beijing, ohun tí àwọn olórí ìlú yìí bá ṣọ lè mú kí ọrọ̀-ajé wọn dojúbolẹ̀. Ó burú ju bíi àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó kù ṣe lérò lọ,” lèrò Abigail Grace, oníwádìí lóri ọ̀rọ̀ Asia láti Center for New American Security -ẹgbẹ́ tó ń ran àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ètò-ìṣúná àti ọrọ̀-ajé.
rows.output: "Whether from Washington or Beijing, what these city leaders are doing can put their economies at risk. It's worse than what most other countries are thinking," said Abigail Grace, a researcher on Asian affairs at the Center for New American Security, a group that helps countries develop economic and financial plans.
rows.reference: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.

rows.source: Zantukan nasa sun zo ne a yayin da Sakataren Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka Mike Pompeo yake dab da sake fara maganar diflomasiyyar da ta ci tura a kan nukiliyar fiye da watanni uku bayan taron Singapore tare da Kim Jong Un na Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.output: His comments came as Secretary of State Mike Pompeo was preparing to restart a diplomatic dialogue with North Korea that had been stalled for more than three months after the Singapore summit with Kim Jong Un of North Korea.
rows.reference: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

rows.source: Ri ya ce wani kawai “mafarki ne” da ke ci gaba da takunkumi da ki na Amurka ga wani furuci wanda kawo ƙarshen Yaƙin Koriya zai taɓa kawo Arewar zuwa ga gwiwowinta.
rows.output: He said that it was just a "dream" that continued to impose American sanctions on a statement that would bring an end to the Korean War would ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.reference: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.

rows.source: Washington tana jin shakkun na yarda da furucin ba tare da Pyongyang da farko ta yi wata muhimmiyar hoɓɓasa na rage makaman ba.
rows.output: Washington is concerned about the possibility of accepting the declaration without Pyongyang first making a significant reduction in its weapons.
rows.reference: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.

rows.source: Gaba ɗaya Kim da Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump suna son wani babban taro na biyu.
rows.output: Overall, Kim and US President Donald Trump are looking for a second big meeting.
rows.reference: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.

rows.source: Amma akwai rashin yarda mai yawa cewa Pyongyang ba ta himmatu sosai ba game da watsi da wani makami da ƙasar ke ganin shi ne kusan kaɗai hanyar garanti ɗinta na samun kariya.
rows.output: But there is a great deal of skepticism that Pyongyang is really committed to giving up a weapon that the country sees as its only guarantee of security.
rows.reference: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.

rows.source: Pompeo yana shirin ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu da Kim da Trump.
rows.output: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next week to prepare for a second summit between Kim and Trump.
rows.reference: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.

rows.source: Nune-nunen kayan ado na Paris ya fito da mafi sabon layi a cikin kayan ka a kan hanyarsa ta zuwa wani Babban Titi kusa da kai
rows.output: The fashion shows of Paris have unveiled the latest trends in your wardrobe on its way to a Grand Boulevard near you
rows.reference: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you

rows.source: Idan kana son kara girman hularka da ka tara ko toshe gaba ɗaya rana shi ke nan kar ka ƙara gaba.
rows.output: If you want to increase the size of your collection or block the entire day, that's it, don't add more.
rows.reference: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.

rows.source: Masu tsara kaya Valentino da Thom Browne sun baje-koli wa kayan kai masu girma da kyau don tarun kayansu na SS19 a kan hanyar wucewa waɗanda suka ƙayatar da salon da aka kafa a Makon Kayan Ado na Paris.
rows.output: Valentino and Thom Browne's accessories designers showcased oversized and exaggerated accessories for their SS19 collections on the Paris Men's Fashion Week catwalks, which captivated the audience with their established aesthetic.
rows.reference: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.

rows.source: Hulunan da ba a iya tunani sun mamaye Instagram wannan damunar kuma waɗannan masu tsara kayan sun zuba idanunsu na ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a ƙasan tattakin nuna salon kaya.
rows.output: The surreal outfits have taken over Instagram this season, and these fashion designers have thrown their creative designs at the feet of the fashion show.
rows.reference: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.

rows.source: Abin da ya fito daga Valentino wata hula ce ta sama da ake sawa da wani gashi da ya mamaye kan masu nuna samfurorin.
rows.output: The result of Valentino is a high priestess who is wearing a hairstyle that is a crown of the models.
rows.reference: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.

rows.source: Sauran manyan abubuwan tallafin sun haɗa da kankana mai kayan ado, wata hular masu da ma wata abarba - amma ba a tsara su don sa dumi a kanka ba.
rows.output: Other notable features include a decorated headband, a hat for men and a scarf - but they were not designed to keep you warm on your own.
rows.reference: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.

rows.source: Thom Browne kuma ya fio da wani zaɓi na ban mamaki safofin fuska - kuma kawai don lokaci na Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne also chose a shocking costume - and only for the time of Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.

rows.source: Da yawa daga cikin safofin fuskar masu launi suna da ɗinki a leɓɓa kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter a maimakon salon ado na haute couture.
rows.output: Many of the colorful masks have a mesh-like texture and look more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture fashion.
rows.reference: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.

rows.source: Wata ƙagowar ya yi kama da kayan shiga ruwan teku na scuba tare da snorkel da tubarau, wani kuwa ya yi kama da bututun ƙanƙarar madara mai narkewa.
rows.output: An old man was carrying a scuba diving kit with a snorkel and flippers, while another was carrying a transparent tube of melting ice cream.
rows.reference: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.

rows.source: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da babban bayani a kan kayan ado - kana cikin nasara.
rows.output: And if you keep up with the big news on accessories - you're a winner.
rows.reference: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.

rows.source: Masu kallon salo sun yi kintace cewa manyan bonnets za su iya fara zuwa manyan titunan na kusa da kai.
rows.output: Fashionistas are predicting that big bonnets could be the next big thing on the streets.
rows.reference: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.

rows.source: Manyan hulunan suna zuwa da kyau a kan takalma masu tsawo na 'La Bomba', hula mai tsinke tare da ƙafofi biyu gajeru da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa ga Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: The big trends are coming in well on the long legs of 'La Bomba', a flared hula with two short legs seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: An watsa irin yadda hular take da ake maitar so sosai a cikin kafofin sada zumunta mai aika wata babbar kirkira har zuwa wurin tattakin nuna salon ado - ga wata jakar kara ta bakin teku kusan babba kamar samfuri na rigar wanka a ruwa da ake sawa.
rows.output: The way the headscarf is styled is so popular that it has been shared on social media, and a big creation has been sent to a fashion show - a giant beach bag almost as big as a bathing suit model wearing it.
rows.reference: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.

rows.source: Jakar mai launin lemo, da aka gyara tare da gefe-gefen raffia mai sama na wani farin mariki na fata, ita ce abin da ya yi fice a cikin kayan La Riviera SS19 na Jacquemus a Makon Kayon Ado na Paris. Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris
rows.output: The yellow canvas tote, reimagined with a raffia top handle and a white leather strap, was the star of Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.

rows.source: Sanannen mai salo Luke Armitage ya fada a FEMAIL: ‘Ina tsammanin ganin manyan huluna da jakakkunan bakin teku sun zo a kan babban titi don damuna ta gaba - don saboda mai tsarawar ya yi wani babban tasiri zai yi wahala a manta da buƙatar ta manyan kayayyakin tallafin.’
rows.output: Renowned stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I think seeing big hats and beach bags come on the scene for my next big thing - because the trend setter has made a big impact it will be hard to forget the need for big statement pieces.'
rows.reference: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'

rows.source: John Edward: Muhimman hikimomin harsuna don ‘yan kasa na duniya
rows.output: John Edward: The most important language principles for the citizens of the world
rows.reference: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens

rows.source: Makarantun Scotland masu zaman kansu suna riƙe da wani rubutaccen bayani na fice ta fuskar ilmi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a cikin 2018 tare da wani yanki na sakamakon jarrabawa da ta yi fice, wanda kawai cin nasara mutum da ta tare cikin wasanni, da fasaha, waƙa da sauran al’amuran al’umma ke ƙarfafawa.
rows.output: Independent schools in Scotland hold a written record of excellence in education, and this continued in 2018 with a section of examination results that were outstanding, which only a handful of people achieved in combination with success in sports, the arts, music and other community activities.
rows.reference: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.

rows.source: Tare da samun ƙarin yara ‘yan makaranta 30,000 a faɗin Scotland, wadannan makarantun, wanda Majalisar Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu (Scottish Council of Independent Schools), ke hoɓɓasa don samar da lebur na aiki mafi kyau ga ƙananan yara da iyayensu.
rows.output: With the addition of 30,000 more school-aged children across Scotland, these schools, which are members of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools, are working to provide the best possible learning experience for young children and their parents.
rows.reference: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.

rows.source: Makarantu masu zaman kansun na da manufa ta shirya yaransu don karin samun babban ilmi, hanyar rayuwa da suka zaɓa da wurinsu a matsayin ‘yan ƙasa na duniya.
rows.output: Independent schools aim to prepare their students for a chosen way of life and for their future as global citizens.
rows.reference: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.

rows.source: A matsayin wani sashe na ilmi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da manhajar makaranta da ake magana, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da da sanuwa da kuma darasi da ake so na zabi a cikin makarantu.
rows.output: As part of the knowledge that can be used to develop and implement school policies, we see that modern languages are constantly being recognized and taught as a subject of choice in schools.
rows.reference: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela ya ce: “Idan ka yi magana da wani mutum a cikin wani harshe da yake fahimta, wannan yakan shiga kansa.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela said: "When you talk to a man in his own language, that language which he understands best, he will never forget you.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.

rows.source: Idan ka yi magana da a cikin harshensa wannan yakan shiga zuciyarsa.”
rows.output: When you speak in his language, this usually gets to his heart.
rows.reference: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."

rows.source: Wannan wata tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci ba a yayin son gina hulɗoɗi da aminci tare da mutane daga sauran ƙasashe.
rows.output: This is a strong reminder that we cannot rely solely on English when we want to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.reference: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.

rows.source: Daga sakamakon jarrabawa na kwanan nan na wannan shekara, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna saman teburan jaddawali tare da kimomi da suka fi girma a cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu.
rows.output: From the recent examination results of this year, we can see that languages are at the top of the priority list with higher scores in private schools.
rows.reference: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.

rows.source: Wata jimillar kashi 68 cikin ɗari ne na ɗalibai da suka karanta harsunan ƙasashen waje suka sami wata Babbar daraja ta A.
rows.output: A total of 68 percent of students who studied foreign languages received a First Class Honors degree.
rows.reference: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.

rows.source: Bayanan, da aka tattara daga mambobin makaranta 74 na SCIS ɗin, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban sun ci wata Babbar daraja ta A a cikin Mandarin, sai kuma kashi 72 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Farasanci da kashi 63 cikin ɗari da ke karanta Spanish su ma sun sami wata A.
rows.output: Data, collected from 74 school members of SCIS, showed that 72% of students received an A in Mandarin, as well as 72% of those who read German, 69% of those who read French, and 63% of those who read Spanish also received an A.
rows.reference: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.

rows.source: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantu masu zaman kansu a cikin Scotland suna goyon bayan harsunan ƙasashen waje a matsayin muhimman hikimomi da yara da samari za su babu shakka buƙata a nan gaba.
rows.output: This indicates that independent schools in Scotland support foreign languages as essential skills that children and young people will undoubtedly need in the future.
rows.reference: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.

rows.source: Harsuna a yanzu, a matsayin darasin zaɓi, ana riƙe su a matsayi iri guda kamar darussan STEM (kimiyya, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin manhajojin makarantun masu zaman kansu da kuma wasu wani wurin.
rows.output: Hausa is now, as an elective course, held in the same status as STEM courses (science, engineering, and mathematics) in the programs of private schools and some other places.
rows.reference: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.

rows.source: Wani safiyo na Hukumar Ingila don Aiki da Hikimomi a cikin 2014 ya samo dalilai da masu ɗaukan aiki suka bayar don gwagwarmaya wajen cike guraben da ba kowa, an danganta kashi 17 cikin ɗari zuwa ga wani rashin isassun hikimomin harsuna.
rows.output: A 2014 survey by the English Language Assessment Service (ELAS) for the Home Office found that 17% of applicants cited a lack of sufficient language skills as a reason for the gaps in their employment history.
rows.reference: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.

rows.source: Don haka hikimomin harshe da yawa sosai suna sake zama da muhimmanci saboda a shirya samari don abubuwan da za su yi nan gaba a rayuwa.
rows.output: So many linguistic skills are once again becoming important because they are preparing children for the things they will do in the future.
rows.reference: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.

rows.source: Tare da ƙarin damammakin aiki da za a iya samu masu buƙatar harsuna, wadannan hikimomi suna da muhimmanci a cikin duniya mai dunƙulewa.
rows.output: With more job opportunities available, these skills are essential in a globalized world.
rows.reference: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.

rows.source: Ba tare da la’akari da irin aiki da wani ya zaɓa na rayuwa ba, idan suka koyi wani harshe na biyu, za su haƙiƙa wata fa’ida a nan gaba mai hikima ta tsawon rayuwa irin wannan:
rows.output: Regardless of the type of work a person chooses to pursue in life, if they learn a second language, they will indeed gain a valuable lifelong skill:
rows.reference: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.

rows.source: Samun dama ta sadarwa kai tsaye tare da mutane daga ƙasashe na waje zai kai tsaye sa wani mutum mai harsuna da yawa a saman gasar.
rows.output: Having direct access to communication with people from other countries will make a multilingual person the top contender.
rows.reference: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.

rows.source: A cewar wani zaɓen jin ra’ayi na YouGov na fiye da manya 4,000 ‘yan Ingila a 2013, kashi 75 cikin ɗari sun gagara su yi magana da wani harshen ƙasar waje sosai yadda za su iya yin tattaunawa da kuma Faransanci da ya zama kawai harshen magana da kashi cikin ɗari na wani gurbin lambobi biyu kawai ta mai lamba, kashi 15 cikin ɗari.
rows.output: According to a YouGov poll of over 4,000 English adults in 2013, 75% struggled to speak a foreign language well enough to have a conversation, with French being the only language spoken by 15% of respondents.
rows.reference: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.

rows.source: Wannan shi ya sa zuba jari a cikin koyar da harshe a yanzu yana da amfani don yaran gobe.
rows.output: This is why investing in language education is now so important for the children of the future.
rows.reference: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.

rows.source: Samun harsuna da yawa, musamman waɗanda na ire-iren tattalin arziki ne masu tasowa, zai ba wa yara wata dama mai kyau ta samun aiki mai ma’ana.
rows.output: Acquiring multiple languages, especially those of developing economies, can provide children with a great opportunity to find meaningful employment.
rows.reference: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.

rows.source: A cikin Scotland, kowace makaranta za ta bambanta a cikin harsuna da suke koyarwa.
rows.output: In Scotland, every school will be different in the languages they teach.
rows.reference: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.

rows.source: Da yawan makarantu za su himmatu ne a kan karin fitattun harsunan zamani, amma dai sauran za su koyar da harsuna da ake ganin mafi amfani don Ingila a yayin duba gaba zuwa 2020, kamar su Mandarin ko Jafanisanci.
rows.output: With many schools committed to increasing the prominence of modern languages, other schools will focus on teaching languages that are considered most useful for England in the future, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.reference: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.

rows.source: Ko ma wace irin sha’awa yaranka ke da ita, koyaushe za a sami wasu harsuna na zaba daga cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu, tare da malamai masu koyarwa da suke kwararru a cikin yankin.
rows.output: No matter what your child's interests are, there will always be a selection of languages to choose from in private schools, with teachers who are experts in the area.
rows.reference: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.

rows.source: Makarantu masu zaman kansu na Scotland suna sadaukar da kai don samar da wani yanayi na koyo da zai shirya yara da ba su karfi na hikimomi da ake nema don ci nasara, duk abin da kuwa zai nan gaba.
rows.output: Independent schools in Scotland are committed to providing a learning environment that prepares young people for the intellectual rigour that is required for success, whatever the future holds.
rows.reference: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.

rows.source: Ba za a iya ki a wannan lokacin ba, a cikin wani yanayin kasuwanci na duniya, harsuna suna ci gaba taka rawa mai amfani ga makomar kasar, don haka dole sa wannan a cikin ilmi.
rows.output: It is not possible to do this now, in a globalized business environment, languages are playing an increasingly important role in the future of the country, so this must be done in education.
rows.reference: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.

rows.source: Hakika, ya kamata a zahiri a dauki harsunan zamani “hikimomin sadarwa na kasa-da-kasa.”
rows.output: In fact, languages should be taken seriously as "national communication strategies."
rows.reference: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."

rows.source: Makarantu masu zaman kansu za su ci gaba da samar da wannan zabin, zama da juna da fice ga samarin mutane na Scotland.
rows.output: Independent schools will continue to provide this choice, and to be a place of belonging and excellence for the sons and daughters of Scotland.
rows.reference: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: We must do it.
rows.reference: Il faut bien le faire.

rows.output: John Edward is the Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.reference: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools

rows.output: The wait is almost over for the fans who are eager to see LeBron James make his debut for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Amma kawai ba san mintina nawa ne zai yi wasan ba har yanzu.
rows.output: But I still don't know how much time I have to play.

rows.source: "Zai zama fiye da daya da kusa da 48" inji Walton a kan shafin yanar gizo na Lakers din.
rows.output: "It will be more than one and closer to 48" Walton said on the Lakers' website.
rows.reference: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.

rows.source: Mai rahoto na Lakers Mike Trudell a Twitter cewa James zai kila yi kayyadedden wasan mintina ne.
rows.output: Reporter Mike Trudell on Twitter that James may play limited minutes.
rows.reference: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.

rows.source: A bayan gwaji na farkon wannan makon, an tambayi James game da shirye-shiryensa don tsarin wasanni shida na kafin lokaci na Lakers.
rows.output: After the first test of this week, James was asked about his plans for the six-game schedule before the Lakers' time.
rows.reference: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.

rows.source: “Ba na bukatar wasanni na kafin lokaci a wannan matakin na aikina don na shirya,” inji shi.
rows.output: "I don't need pre-season games at this stage of my career because I'm prepared," he said.
rows.reference: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.

rows.source: Shugaba Donald Trump ya fara ‘yan wasu taruka yau da dare a cikin Wheeling, Virginia ta Yamma.
rows.output: President Donald Trump began some rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: “Shi ne farkon daya daga cikin tarukan Trump guda biyar a cikin mako mai zuwa da ya hada da tsaye-tsaye a wuraren da ke abota da suka da Tennessee da Mississippi.

rows.output: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, who is charged in the New York City attack that killed eight people - a punishment not previously available in the state for federal crimes since 1953.
rows.reference: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, used a rental truck to carry out the attack on a bike path in Lower Manhattan, targeting pedestrians and cyclists in October.

rows.output: To confirm the death sentence, the prosecutors will prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed eight people and "knowingly" caused severe physical injury to others, according to the notice of the death sentence, filed in the Southern District of New York.

rows.output: A few weeks after the attack, the federal court in Manhattan charged Saipov with 22 counts, including eight counts of terrorism, typically brought by prosecutors in terrorism cases, and charges of destruction of vehicles.

rows.source: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."
rows.output: This attack required "significant planning and execution," the prosecutors said, describing how Saipov viewed it as "a heinous, cruel and cowardly act."

rows.output: They don't care who they wrong, who they have to climb over to get power and control, that's what they want power and control, and we won't give it to them."
rows.reference: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."

rows.source: Na mkpa nke iwu akụnụba obodo ziri ezi, nche obodo, yana Europe, n’ụzọ ọzọ otu nsogbu ndị Jeremy jiri na ekwenyeghị na ndị isi gara aga.

rows.source: Ọkwa maka nzụkọ Nottingham East Labour na Fraịde kwuru na “anyị chọrọ nzụkọ ndị ahụ bụrụ nke dum ma mịpụta mkpụrụ.”
rows.output: The meeting for the Nottingham East Labour Party on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be full and fruitful."
rows.reference: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."

rows.source: N’imirikiti afọ asatọ m ka MP Labour mpaghara ahụ, abalị Fraịde nzụkọ GC na abụkarị nke ahụ.
rows.output: In the eight years I've been an MP, the Labour Party's area meeting on Friday nights has always been the highlight.
rows.reference: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.

rows.source: Na mwute taa, ọ bụghị olu nke imirikiti nzụkọ yana ndọrọndọrọ “obi ọma, ume ala” ekwere na nkwa bụ ihe ndị echefugoro kemgbe ma ọ bụrụ, n’ezie, o bidoro ma ncha.
rows.output: Today, it is the voice of the arrogant and the complacent "good intentions, empty promises" that are forgotten since, if at all, they were never really clean.
rows.reference: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.

rows.source: Ọ bụ ihe pụtara ihie nke ukwuu na anaghị anabata nghọta dị iche iche na ndọrọndọrọ Labour, ọzọkwa a na ekpezi echiche ọ bụla ma a ga-anabata ya n’ọchịchị ndọrọndọrọ ahụ.
rows.output: It is a very serious matter that there is no room for different interpretations in the Labour Party, and any idea that is not accepted will be rejected by the party leadership.
rows.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

rows.source: Nke a bidoro ozugbo Jeremy bụrụ onye isi, ndị ọrụ ibe m, ndị m chere na mụ na ha na ekekọrịta otu nghọta ndọrọndọrọ bidoro tụba anya na m ga-atụgharị ozugbo ma were ọnọdụ ndị m ga-agaghị ekwekọrịta na ya otu ọ bụla - ma ọ bụ na nchedo obodo ma ọ bụ otu ahịa EU.
rows.output: This began immediately after Jeremy became leader, my colleagues, with whom I had shared a common understanding of the party, started to look at me and I would have to change direction and take positions that I would not have agreed with on either national security or the single market.
rows.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

rows.source: Mgbe ọ bụla m kwuru okwu n’ọhaneze - ọ gaghị agbasata ihe m kwuru - a na enwe nkwụtọ dị ukwuu na esote ozugbo n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze na akpọ maka mwepu, nkatọ ndọrọndọrọ nke etiti, na agwa m na m ekwesịghị ịnọ na ndọrọndọrọ Labour.
rows.output: Whenever I speak in public - it will not be in line with what I said - there is usually a lot of discontent and immediately after the meeting, a call for removal, criticism of the party's leadership, and my behavior that I should not be in the Labour Party.
rows.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

rows.source: Ma nke a abụghị naanị m.
rows.output: But this is not just me.
rows.reference: And that is not just my experience.

rows.source: N’ezie, ama m na m ka nwee ihu ọma karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m n’ihi asịsa ndị ezitere m na abụkarị maka ndọrọndọrọ.
rows.output: Of course, I must have a better face than some of my colleagues because of the lies that were sent to me and I was always for the election.

rows.source: Enwere m ntụmanya n’arụmọrụ na mkpebi nke ndị ọrụ ibe m ndị ahụ na enweta nkatọ okike mmadụ ma ọ bụ agbụrụ ya kwa ụbọchị mana ha anaghị agba ọsọ.
rows.output: I have a feeling that my colleagues who are constantly receiving negative feedback from their superiors are not motivated to work hard.
rows.reference: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.

rows.source: Otu n’ime akụkụ kachasị ada mmụọ nke oge ndọrọndọrọ a bụ otu okwu nkatọ ndị jọrọ njọ si buru ihe nkịtị.
rows.output: One of the most depressing aspects of this era is the tendency to be overly critical of everything.
rows.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

rows.output: The truth is that we are not talking about the spread of the virus, and any "doubt" or change in the election law, the election is also a matter of fact.
rows.reference: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.

rows.output: I've had a lot of advice over the past two years to be humble and to stop talking so much, and I'm not going to have any problems.

rows.output: But that's not what I'm about.

rows.source: Kemgbe m sonyere Labour afọ 32 ka nwa akwụkwọ, nke nlegharị anya gọọmentị Thatcher kpalitere, nke hapụrụ ime ụlọ akwụkwọ m na nnukwu mmebi, achọrọ m na mbụ idu ọrụ mara mma nke ọhaneze maka ndị kachasị chọọ ha - ma abụ m onye ndu obere mpaghara ma ọ bụ minista gọọmentị.
rows.output: Since I joined the Labour Party 32 years ago as a student, inspired by the government's policies of Thatcher, which left my school in a state of disrepair, I have always wanted to lead a public service that is truly for the people who need it most - whether as a local council leader or government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

rows.source: Ezobeghị m ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị m na mbụ, gụnyere ntuli aka ikpeazụ.

rows.reference: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.

rows.source: Ọnweghị onye ọ bụla nọ na Nottingham East ga-enwe mgbagwoju anya gbasara ọnọdụ iwu m yana mpaghara ndị mụ ekwenyeghị n’ọchịchị dị ugbu a.
rows.output: No one in Nottingham East should be in any doubt about my legal position and the areas where I disagree with the current administration.
rows.reference: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.

rows.source: Maka ndị ahụ kwadoro ụkpụrụ ahụ na Fraịde, ihe niile m nwere ike ikwu bụ na mgbe obodo na aga ịnwe Brexit ga-enwe mmetụta adịghị mma n’ọtụtụ ezinụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọhaneze anyị, aghọtaghị m agụụ iji gbuo oge na ike maka nkwado m na ndị isi ndọrọndọrọ Labour.
rows.output: For those who supported the motion on Friday, all I can say is that when the country goes through Brexit, it will have a negative impact on many families, businesses, and public services in our country, I do not understand the appetite to waste time and energy in supporting the Labour leadership.
rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.source: Mana n’eziokwu otu ozi m nwere abụghị maka Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ maka ndị mmebe m, ma ọ bụ ndị otu Labour ma ha abụghị: Enwere m afọ ojuju ijere unu ozi ma na ekwe nkwa na ọnweghị ihe egwu mwepu ole ma ọ bụ ngwangwa ndọrọndọrọ ga-akwụsị m ịme ihe m kwere kachasị dịịrị unu niile mma.
rows.output: But one message I have is not about Nottingham Momentum, it's about my builders, or the Labour Party, but they are not: I am pleased to serve you and I promise that no threat of electoral loss or internal party discipline will stop me from doing what I believe is best for all of you.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.

rows.output: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Thanks to Ayr, they took their chances more than we did."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."

rows.source: Ọnwụnwa nkeji 14 nke Grant Anderson, nke Frazier Climo mezuru n’isi, tinyere Ayr n’ihu, enyere kaadị edo-edo maka onye isi Scotland Rory Hughes, nke ndị Warriors hapụrụ maka egwuregwu ahụ, nyere Melrose ohere ịme ka ọnụọgụ nyere ha aka, ma Jason Baggot nwetere ọnwụnwa emezughi n’isi.
rows.output: 14th-minute penalty by Grant Anderson, converted by Frazier Climo in the 19th minute, gave Ayr the lead, but Melrose equalized after Scotland captain Rory Hughes was sent off for the match, allowing Melrose to take advantage, and Jason Baggot scored an unconverted try in the 76th minute.
rows.reference: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.

rows.source: Climo dọtịrị ndu Ayr ahụ site na iji penalti, tupu, ozugbo n’ọkara oge, ọ nyere goolu wee mezuo ọnwụnwa naanị ya iji mee ya 17-5 nke Ayr na nkejioge.
rows.output: Climo pulled the Ayr lead from the penalty spot, before, at half-time, he gave a goal and completed the individual penalty to make it 17-5 Ayr in the first half.
rows.reference: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.

rows.source: Mana Melrose bidoro agba nke abụọ nke ọma yanakwa ọnwụnwa Patrick Anderson, nke Bagoot mezuru n’isi, belatara oghere ahụ ka ọ bụrụ akara ise.
rows.output: Mana Melrose malitere agba nke abụọ nke ọma na ọnwụnwa Patrick Anderson, nke Bagoot mezuru n'isi, belata oghere ahụ ka ọ bụrụ akara ise.
rows.reference: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.

rows.source: Enwere nnukwu ogbugbu oge maka nnukwu mmerụ ahụ Ruaridh Knott nwetara, onye nke ebupuru, na mmalitegharị, Ayr gatere aka site na ọnwụnwa Stafford McDowall, nke Climo mezuru n’isi.
rows.output: There is a significant delay in the treatment of Ruaridh Knott's serious injury, who was taken to the hospital, and then returned to the field, Ayr managed to score a goal through Stafford McDowall, which Climo completed in the first half.
rows.reference: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.

rows.source: Osote kaptịn Ayr bụ Blair Macpherson nwetara kaadị edo-edo, ọzọkwa, Melrose mekwara ka nwoke ọzọ baa uru site na ọnwụnwa Bruce Colvine emezughi, na ngwụcha nke oge nnukwu ọkụ ahụ.
rows.output: Vice-captain Ayr Blair Macpherson was yellow-carded, as was Melrose, while another man was sent off by referee Bruce Colvine, at the end of the big fire.
rows.reference: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.

rows.source: Otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ laghachitere, kaosiladị, mgbe enyere Struan Hutchinson kaadị edo-edo maka ịgba Climo ụkwụ onye na ejighi bọọlụ, na mpụga nke ahịrị penalti, MacPherson daturu n’azụ nke nsogbu Ayr na abịa ihu.
rows.output: The team returned to the house, in a state of chaos, after Struan Hutchinson was given a yellow card for tripping Climo, who was offside, outside the penalty area, and MacPherson scored a goal in the back of the Ayr problem and came face to face.
rows.reference: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.

rows.source: Climo gbanyere ya, dị ka ọ mechara ntakịrị ọzọ na mbidogharị, ka Kyle Rowe jidere ọgbụgba n’ime bọksị nke David Armstrong wee zipu onye nke akụkụ Gregor Henry maka ọnwụnwa nke ise nke otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ.
rows.output: Climo climbed on him, as if he had just a little more to go on the comeback trail, as Kyle Rowe took a throw-in inside the box of David Armstrong and sent the fifth substitute of the team into the house.
rows.reference: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
